IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_fate_warn_1: We're out of everything. The crew's gonna walk.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_fate_goodbye_: This is the last call. Survive on your own.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_project_done_: The trading post is open! Less robbing, more selling.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_project_progr: Thanks to you, the trading post is %1%% done. Funny, huh?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_crisis_appeal: You heard about the %1? Take my side. Pick in your quest log.
About the %1. Work with me and you get a cut. Check your quest log.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_crisis_thanks: Turns out that works for me too. Thanks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_crisis_snub_1: You picked them? Fine. I'll remember that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_world_power_1: Power's out. Generators are gold now. Got something to sell.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_world_water_1: Water's off. Maybe I'll start selling it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_world_winter_: Winter. Stock up on smokes if you don't wanna freeze.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_chat_morning_: Morning. Got anywhere worth looting today?
You up? My crew's still sleeping.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_chat_evening_: Sun's going down. Wander at night and you die.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_chat_miss_1: You've been quiet. Thought you were dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_chat_checkin_: Just calling. Got anything worth trading?
Dutch is acting up again. Annoying.
Prices are going up. Just so you know.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_offline_reply: Can't hear a damn thing over the static. Later.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_offer_1: Here's what I'll part with. Look at the terms.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_offer_2: Got that. Here's the price. Don't bother haggling.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_gift_1: This once, it's free. Don't get used to it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_refuse_1: Not selling that to you. Not yet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_open_chat_1: Coalfield Crew. Got stuff to buy or sell, speak up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_open_chat_2: Made a good haul in town today. Jealous?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_extort_1: Hand over %1. You've got %2 hours. Or the dead come knocking.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_extort_2: Bring %1 within %2 hours. I'm not joking.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_extort_paid_1: Smart. I'll leave you alone, for now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_work_horde_1: Do some cleaning instead. Clear the zombies around a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_work_fetch_1: No goods? Then work it off. Sealed package in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. Bring it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_work_courier_: Run a delivery. Grab a parcel in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you, take it where I say. Don't open it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_work_credit_1: On credit. Don't pay in %1 days and you know what happens.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_work_favor_1: Take it. But it's a debt. I'll come collecting.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_work_done_1: Not bad. Threw in a little extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_named_ask_1: I don't usually ask. %1... turned. Shuffling around near %2, about %4 tiles %3 of you. Put them down and bring me what they had.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_holiday_soon_: %1's coming, huh? My crew wants a drink. Gather some stuff.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_holiday_feast: It's %1. Sent some food. Be grateful.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_supply_drop: Left you something. Building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you. Get it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_fetch_1: A favor. There's a %4 in a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you. Call when you have it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_fetch_2: Bring me a %4. Near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you. I'll pay.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_rescue_1: Distress call. Someone's trapped in a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you. I can't go. You go.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_rescue_2: Someone's asking for help. Near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_reward_1: Got it. What I owe is in a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_reward_2: Good. Your pay's in a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_reward_trad: Paid. Goods are in a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_reward_hord: Got them all. Your pay's in a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
Good work. Building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_request_1: I need %1. Bring it. I'll pay. Answer on the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_horde_1: %4 of them at a building near %1. %3 tiles %2 of you. Clear them. I'll pay.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_horde_2: %4 gathered near %1. %3 tiles %2 of you. That's my trap line.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_heli_1: Helicopter. Flying low. It'll pull them in. Stay clear.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_crisis_appe: You heard about the %1. Help me. Quest log.
About the %1. Pick my side. It's in your quest log.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_world_power: Power's out. Never had it anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_world_winte: Winter. Woods are frozen. Set your traps early.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_chat_evenin: Sun's going down. Don't light a fire. They'll come.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_chat_checki: Two rabbits in the traps. You?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_offer_1: I can give you this. Look at the terms.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_open_chat_2: Saw a deer today. A live one.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_work_horde_: Work instead of goods. Clear them out around a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_work_scout_: Go have a look. First is a building near %1, %3 tiles %2. Get inside and watch a while. They're in there.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_work_favor_: Take it. You'll do me one later.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_work_done_1: Good work. Put in a bit extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_named_ask_1: %1 turned. Near %2, %4 tiles %3. Put them down. Bring what they carried.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_1: I keep a notebook of frequencies and spend my evenings trying to raise Louisville, where my Annie lived. No answer yet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_2: The garden's finally coming in, but raccoons and the dead keep trampling it. I'm planting extra for when Annie comes home.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_3: Last night I heard a faint woman's voice on the radio. Might've been Louisville. I need batteries to keep listening through the night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_4a: With the batteries I caught that voice again. It was Annie, alive, at a church shelter in Louisville. I'm overjoyed and scared all at once.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_4t: The food off that crashed truck fed my neighbors for a week. They promised to watch the farm while I go to Louisville.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_4b: The batteries died and I lost the voice. My own fault. I sleep poorly and I've been drinking at night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_5: I'm fixing up my old pickup to drive to Louisville for Annie, but the battery's dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_5b: I want to try reaching Louisville one more time, but the radio needs parts to reach that far.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_6a: I left the farm in my pickup to find Annie in Louisville. I'll radio from the road when I can. Full of hope, and nerves.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_6b: The pickup never started. I stay on the farm, tending the garden for a daughter I may never see again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray_end_bad: I gave up on Louisville. I don't talk like I used to, and some days I leave the radio off.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_1: Dad's been coughing for days and runs a fever at night. I read library medical books between broadcasts.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_2: Dad's fever keeps climbing and I have nothing to bring it down.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_3a: The fever broke a little! I'm building a bigger antenna on the roof so I can reach more people.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_3b: Dad got worse. I barely sleep. I keep the radio on just to hear another voice.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_4s: Thanks to your help my signal reached survivors in Brandenburg! We talk every night and I can't stop smiling.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_4x: That strange signal went silent before I could answer. It hurt that nobody helped, but I'm trying not to show it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_4: Dad's cough turned into a chest infection. I need real medicine now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_4b: Dad's fighting for breath. I'm so scared. If anyone has medicine, please help.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_5a: Dad's getting better! I'm teaching him Morse code from his bed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey_5b: Dad... died. I'm alone in the radio shack now. I'll keep broadcasting so nobody else has to feel alone.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_1: The clinic has four patients, including a teenage boy with a badly broken leg who asks me every morning when he can walk.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_2: The boy's leg needs setting properly and I'm out of splints.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_3a: The boy's walking on a crutch and teasing the other patients. I laughed for the first time in weeks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_3b: The leg healed crooked. He'll limp for life. It's bitter, how little I have to work with.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_4f: The medicine you brought stopped the fever in the clinic. Nobody died. I keep saying it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_4x: The fever took one of my patients because the medicine went elsewhere. I'd rather not talk about it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_4: A stranger stumbled in with a deep gash, and I have nothing left to close it with.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_5a: The clinic is stable. I'm training recovered patients as helpers, and I've started to sleep a little.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc_5b: I lost the stranger. I'm thinking about closing the clinic. ...I'm exhausted.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_1: Twelve refugees sleep in the church. Last night there was a quarrel over rations and I had to step between two men.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_2: The pantry's nearly empty, and there are children to feed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_3a: My flock is fed. They've started a garden behind the church, and they sing while they work.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_3b: Two hungry families left for the city. I pray for them every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_4r: Thanks to you the church held when Vic's crew came sniffing around. My people call you friends now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_4x: Vic's crew cleaned out the church storeroom. I've forgiven them, but my people are frightened.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_4: The dead pressed against the church doors last night. I must board the windows before they return.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_5a: The church is a true refuge now. I ring the bell on Sundays and people come from miles around.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike_5b: The dead broke in one night and three of my people died. My fault. I've moved everyone to the basement.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_1: I'm building a truck out of three wrecks. Calling it the Ark. Big enough to get a dozen people out of the county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_2: The Ark's engine needs parts I can't find anywhere.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_3a: The Ark's engine turned over for the first time! I whooped so loud the dead came to the fence.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_3b: The Ark's engine seized. Damn it, that set me back weeks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_4s: Wire from the relay tower let me rig lights and a radio into the Ark. Looks like a real rescue truck now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_4: The Ark needs a battery and armor plating before it can leave the garage.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_5a: The Ark runs! I can give rides. Someday I want a whole convoy out of the county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey_5b: The Ark's shelved. I fix other people's cars now, grumbling. ...Haven't given up on it, though.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_1: My squad is down to seven. Command hasn't answered in weeks. We keep the watch schedule anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_2: Two privates were overheard talking about deserting. I put them on double watch and said nothing more.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_3: A fever is spreading through the camp and the aid kit is empty.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_4a: The fever is beaten and the squad is loyal again. I admit civilians came through for us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_4b: One soldier died of the fever and two deserted in the night. Nothing more to say.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_4t: The military cargo from the crashed truck restocked the camp. We're planning to retake the highway checkpoint.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_5: We're planning an operation to clear the highway checkpoint. We need ammunition and field dressings.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_6a: The squad cleared the highway checkpoint. Civilians can pass through safely now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard_6b: The operation failed and the squad fell back to camp. That's all.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_1: My crew's six people. My second, Dutch, keeps saying we should rob survivors instead of scavenging.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_2: Dutch took two guys out on a 'job' without asking me. I'm pretending it doesn't bother me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_3: Payday's coming and the crew's restless. I need something to hand out to keep them loyal.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_4a: Kept the crew in line. Dutch is sulking in a corner, which suits me fine.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_4b: Dutch challenged me openly and half the crew listened to him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_4r: The church job paid off. The crew loves me again. Dutch went quiet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_5: I want to crack the old bank vault in Coalfield. One big score to prove I'm still the boss.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_6a: The vault score made me untouchable. I'm turning the crew into traders. Less raiding.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats_6b: Dutch took over the crew. I still call sometimes... they're more dangerous now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_1: A big black bear keeps raiding my traps. I'm tracking it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_2: Found a dead hiker in the woods. Buried him. Nothing more to say.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_3: The bear hurt my dog. I mean to finish it. Low on rifle rounds.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_4a: Got the bear. Smoked meat for weeks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_4b: The bear killed my dog. Buried it by the creek.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_4s: Scouted the signal tower myself. Bandit bait. Only telling you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_5: Winter comes early in the woods. I need new trap lines.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter_6b: Winter prep failed. Thinking about leaving the county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_chat_1_b: Close my eyes and I hear moaning. You?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_chat_2_a: What did we used to do this time of day?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_chat_3_a: I'm hungry. I want something hot.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_chat_3_b: I'll heat up a can. Best I can do.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_chat_4_a: I'd be done for without you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_chat_4_b: Same goes for me. Let's stick together.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_fight_1_a: Huh... is that all of them?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_fight_2_b: I'm fine. You've got blood on you, yours?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_fight_3_a: We made too much noise. More are coming.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_danger_2_b: Don't fight. We slip out the back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_danger_3_b: We take turns on watch. I'll go first.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_hurt_1_b: Let me see. We'll wrap it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_hurt_2_b: Sit down. I'll take a look.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_hurt_3_b: Don't push it. I'll take point today.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_mood_1_b: Talk if you want. I'm listening.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_mood_2_b: Don't know. But we made it through today.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_mood_3_b: Yeah, let's rest. I'll keep watch.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_good_1_b: We needed a day like this.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_bad_1_b: We'll do better next time. Alive means another chance.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_bad_2_b: No. We both did our best.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_death_2_b: We'll remember them. At least we will.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_help_1_a: Looks like we've got some backup.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_radio_1_b: Yeah. Not sure we can trust it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Banter_radio_2_a: There really are people on the other end.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_open_stayed_home_: I barely left my place near %1 today.
Spent the whole day holed up near %1.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_open_local_scaven: Spent the day picking through the streets near %1.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_open_expedition_1: Today I went far out from %1.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_open_expedition_2: Made a long trip away from %1. My legs are shaking.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_open_combat_day_1: Today was one fight after another.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_open_combat_day_2: Kept running into the dead around %1.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_kills_many: Put down %1 of them. My arms are shaking too hard to hold the pen.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_kills_none: Didn't have to fight a single one, thank god.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_hurt: I got hurt, too. I need to watch the wound.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_act_craft: Made a few things with my hands.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_act_forage: Foraged for food and useful bits.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_act_plant: Planted seeds. Someday they'll come up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_act_burn_corpse: Burned corpses. The smell is still in my nose.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_supply: Found the supplies someone left for us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_fetch: Found what we were asked for and handed it over.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_rescue: Went where the distress call came from. We were too late.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_declined: Turned down %1. It doesn't sit right.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_npc_dead: Heard over the radio that %1 is dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_npc_gone: %1 went off the air for good.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_heli: A helicopter flew low. The dead followed it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_hunted: A pack of the dead wouldn't stop following us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_world_power: The power went out. Real darkness now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_world_winter: Winter came. The nights are freezing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_world_day30: It's been a month since it began.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_note_banter: Talked with my companions for a while.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_mood_SICK: I feel sick. Hope tomorrow's better.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Diary_mood_HUNGRY: I'm hungry. We need more food.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Memoir_class_local_scav: Survived day to day scavenging the neighborhood.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Memoir_class_expedition: Was never afraid to go far.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Memoir_friend: Spent the longest time at %1's side.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Memoir_voice: %1's voice over the radio kept them company the longest.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Memoir_end_1: That is how one person held on in this place.

IGUI_StoryEngine_TradeAsk_Short: They're short on this too, so it costs more

IGUI_StoryEngine_Radio_Error_blackout: The relay tower is down; the signal doesn't reach

IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Why_burned: After the broken promise, no credit or favors for two weeks
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Tooltip: Pay with work instead of goods (the job is picked at random: clearing, scouting, guarding or delivering, all with a little extra), or take it on credit or as a favor. Not paying back credit or a favor costs a lot of trust. Up to 2 a week per contact in total.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_scout_desc: Enter 2-4 buildings in turn and stay within 10 tiles of each for 20 minutes. The dead are inside. From tier 3 the time only counts at night (21:00-05:00). Goods plus extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_guard_desc: Hold out near the marked building (20 tiles) for the set time. 1.5x a clearing's worth of the dead come in waves. Goods plus extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_courier_desc: Pick up a parcel and carry it to another building. A pack follows the carrier, and the parcel starts at 150 percent and is damaged by every wound (down to 100 percent it cuts the extra, below that the goods). Short deadline.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_credit_desc: Get the goods now and pay (10 percent more) within two weeks. Miss it and trust drops sharply (10-20) and this contact won't give credit or favors for two weeks. Needs trust 60.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_favor_desc: Get the goods now for nothing (no trust change). About two days later they ask a favor; refusing, ignoring or failing it drops trust sharply (10-20) and blocks credit and favors with them for two weeks. Needs trust 40.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Why_owed: You already owe this contact a favor
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Why_week: Already done twice with this contact this week
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_trade: Payment: %1 in progress (the [Payment] quest in your list)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_credit: You took the goods on credit. Pay before the deadline.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Hint: You can also pay with work, credit or a favor ([Other payment...]).
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_FavorOwed: Taken as a favor. You must answer this contact's next request.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Title_courier_pick: Payment to %1: pick up a parcel
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_horde: Kill most of the dead around the marked building. Then the traded goods arrive with something extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_fetch: Find the sealed package in the building and [Submit by radio]. Then the traded goods arrive.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_scout: Go inside the marked building and stay within %1 tiles of it for the set time. When every point is done, the traded goods arrive with something extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_guard: Hold out within %1 tiles of the marked building for the set time. Packs of the dead will come. Then the goods arrive with something extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_courier_picku: Pick up the parcel from the building. Then you'll be told where to take it. A pack of the dead will follow you once you have it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Goal_courier_dropo: Carry the parcel to within %1 tiles of the marked building. Getting hurt damages the parcel.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Chosen_horde: Paying with work: clearing a horde
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Chosen_fetch: You'll pay by retrieving a package
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Chosen_courier: Paying with work: delivering a parcel
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Error_owed: You already owe this contact a favor
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Error_week: Already done twice with this contact this week
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Error_no_building: Couldn't find a building for the job. Try again somewhere else.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_Error_not_open: Payment for this trade is already settled
IGUI_StoryEngine_Holiday_Notice: %2 days to %1 - gather holiday ingredients (quest tab)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Holiday_CollectGoal: Send ingredients by the holiday morning ([Send by radio]). If it fills up there's a feast, the contacts' spirits rise and givers gain a little trust. Holiday food lifts your mood.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_Goal: Find %1, who has turned, put them to rest, take the %2 they carried and [Submit by radio]. The map marker follows where they were last seen.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_Slain: You put %1 to rest. Take the %2 from where they fell.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_jim_desc: Ray's neighbor of twenty years, who helped rebuild his barn after the '88 storm. Wore his late wife's wedding ring on a cord. Dressed as a farmer.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_leed_desc: Casey's high school science teacher, who gave Casey a first radio kit and stayed after class to help solder it. Kept a photo album of her students. Dressed as a teacher.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_dad_desc: Died in his sickbed, rose again and walked out of the radio shack. Always wore the brown watch Casey gave him. Office clothes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_maria_desc: A nurse who worked night shifts with June. On the last day she went back in for the patients. Her watch was a gift from her daughter. Nurse's uniform.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_eleanor_desc: The church organist who played every Sunday for thirty years and never took off her crucifix. Lost the night the dead came to the church doors. Wears a skirt.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_tommy_desc: Dewey's old partner at the garage, who taught her engines. Scratched his initials into his wrench. Mechanic's overalls.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_reyes_desc: A nineteen-year-old private of Whitaker's squad, bitten on a supply run and left behind. His dog tags belong to his family. Army uniform.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_joey_desc: The youngest of Vic's crew, a loudmouth kid Vic took in. Always carried his mother's locket. Punk clothes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_earl_desc: Hank's hunting partner for forty years. Used a hunting knife with a bone handle he carved himself. Hunter's clothes.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Work_labor_desc: Take one of clearing, scouting, guarding or delivering, picked at random. It can't be changed afterwards. Finish it for the goods plus extra (a bundle one tier lower). <LINE> Clearing: kill 80 percent of the dead around a building <LINE> Guarding: hold out for the set time while 1.5x a clearing's worth of the dead come in waves <LINE> Scouting: enter 2-4 buildings with the dead inside and stay 20 minutes at each, only at night from tier 3 <LINE> Delivering: a pack follows whoever carries the parcel, every wound damages it and cuts the extra and then the goods, short deadline

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_ray_duo_warm_open_: %1, all quiet over there? Good to hear your voice.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_ray_topic_reply_2: I heard too, %1. Doesn't sit well with me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_ray_topic_reply_3: Yes, %1. All the more reason to look out for each other.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_ray_player_greet_2: Hear you fine, %1. What is it?

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_doc_duo_warm_close: Get some rest, %1. I'll call again.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_pike_topic_reply_1: Indeed, %1. We must look after one another.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_pike_topic_reply_2: I heard as well, %1. My heart aches.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_pike_topic_reply_3: Well said, %1. Let us endure together.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_pike_player_greet_: I hear you, %1. Thank God you're safe.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_dewey_duo_cold_rep: Hmph, I don't like you either, %1.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_doc_reward_waived_: You're leaving the reward for us? Thank you. It will go to my patients.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_pike_volunteer_ask: I have nothing to repay you with, but I thank you for the kindness. It's a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_pike_volunteer_don: You gave without asking anything back. I will remember it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_pike_reward_waived: You'd leave your share to us? We'll share it out with thanks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_dewey_volunteer_as: Nothing to give you, and you'll still do it? Thanks. It's a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_dewey_volunteer_do: Did the whole thing for free. I won't forget that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_dewey_reward_waive: You're just leaving it? Thanks. I'll use it well.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_guard_volunteer_as: There is no pay. If you volunteer anyway, you're welcome. Building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_guard_volunteer_do: Unpaid task completed. Your commitment is noted.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_guard_reward_waive: You're declining the supplies? Appreciated. They'll be put to use.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_volunteer_ask: Doing it for free? You're an odd one. Fine. Building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_volunteer_don: You really did it all for nothing. I'll remember that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_rats_reward_waived: Handing that over to us? Bad deal for you. Thanks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_volunteer_a: Nothing to give you. If you'll do it anyway, thanks. Building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_volunteer_d: Did it for nothing. Won't forget.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_hunter_reward_waiv: Leaving it? Thanks. We'll make it last.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Tooltip: Do a job for this contact for no pay and earn their trust. The job is random: clearing, scouting, guarding or delivering. <LINE> Next job: tier %1, trust +%2 when done (lost if you fail) <LINE> Left this week: %3
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Tooltip_Perso: Do a job for this contact for no pay and earn their trust in you. The job is random: clearing, scouting, guarding or delivering. <LINE> Next job: tier %1, your trust +%2 when done (lost if you fail) <LINE> Left this week for you: %3 (per player)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Why_open: You are already doing a job for them
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Why_week: You already did two jobs for them this week
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Header: Helping %1 for no pay - trust +%2 when done
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Goal_horde: Kill most of the dead around the marked building. No pay; your trust goes up when it's done.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Goal_scout: Go inside the marked building and stay within %1 tiles of it for the set time. When every point is done, your trust goes up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Goal_guard: Hold out within %1 tiles of the marked building for the set time. Packs of the dead will come. Your trust goes up when it's done.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Volunteer_Goal_courier_: Pick up the parcel from the building. Then you'll be told where to take it. A pack of the dead will follow you once you have it.
Carry the parcel to within %1 tiles of the marked building. Your trust goes up when it arrives.
IGUI_StoryEngine_TrustReason_volunteer_f: failed a job they offered to do
IGUI_StoryEngine_Life_Rec_volunteer_fail: failed a job they offered to do
IGUI_StoryEngine_Life_Rec_reward_waived: left them a reward they had earned
IGUI_StoryEngine_Waive_Tooltip: Don't take the reward; leave it to the contact. Their trust goes up and their camp is better off. Only while nothing has been taken.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Waive_Done: You left the reward to them (trust +%1)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Waive_Error_taken: Something was already taken; it can't be left now
IGUI_StoryEngine_Waive_Error_letter: There's a letter in it. Go and pick it up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mini_OpenTip: Open the full window on the last call's channel
IGUI_StoryEngine_Mini_Empty: New radio calls show up here.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Keys_MiniTip: A small window with just the radio talk
IGUI_StoryEngine_People_NoHistory: Nothing written down yet. Their story grows as time goes on.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_trust_20: Came to trust the players enough to trade
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_trust_60: Came to see the players as friends
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_trust_80: Counts the players among the people they trust most
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_crisis_ally: %1 - helping the others helped here too
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_crisis_spared: %1 - the others got the help, and that was understood
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_crisis_ignored: %1 - asked for help and nobody answered
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_fate_gone: Left the county and went off the air
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_death_1: Heard that %1, someone they knew, died
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quick_Loading: Getting camp info... open it again in a moment
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quick_DockTip: Click to show or hide the contacts' specialties. Drag the grip on the left to move it. The number is how many you can call right now
IGUI_StoryEngine_Quick2_DockTip: Click to open or close the second specialty list. Drag the handle on the left to move it. The number is how many you can use right now
IGUI_StoryEngine_Float_MainTip: Click to open the Story Engine window (radio, quests, journal, camps, people), or close it if it's open. The number counts new contact messages since you last had it open. Drag the grip on the left to move it
IGUI_StoryEngine_Keys_Quick: Expand or collapse the skills icon
IGUI_StoryEngine_Keys_QuickTip: Expands or collapses the specialty icon on screen (shows it again if hidden)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_family: Daughter Annie - lived in Louisville. Alive or dead, he doesn't know
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_family_aliv: Daughter Annie - alive at a church shelter in Louisville
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_family_lost: Daughter Annie - no word since the radio lost her
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_home_road: On the road to Louisville (his old pickup)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_bio: A trucker who spent years on Kentucky roads, now alone in a farmhouse outside West Point. Warm, talkative, lonely and a little too trusting. Has some canned food and a bit of medicine, and every evening turns the radio dial hoping to reach his daughter Annie in Louisville.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_family_re: Father - recovering, learning Morse code from bed
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_home: Valley Station, her father's radio shack
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_job: High school student, ham radio operator
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_bio: A sixteen-year-old girl who broadcasts all day from her father's radio shack. Talks fast and gets nervous, but knows batteries, radios, generators and wiring as well as any adult. Tries to sound older than she is and is desperate for someone to talk to. Reads a short evening news broadcast at 19:00 on 105.4 MHz.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_family: Doesn't talk about family. Cares for four patients at the clinic (including a boy with a broken leg)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_family_boy_: Clinic patients - the boy with the broken leg walks on a crutch
Clinic patients - the boy's leg healed crooked; he'll limp for life
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_home_stable: Riverside clinic - recovered patients help out
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_home_closin: Riverside clinic - thinking about closing it
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_bio: A former ER nurse who keeps a small clinic running in Riverside for a handful of wounded survivors. Calm, direct, exhausted, with a dry sense of humour. Rations medicine carefully, asks one or two sharp questions about an injury, then gives practical advice. Won't waste supplies on people who lie to her.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_family: Twelve refugees sheltering in the church
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_family_two: Refugees - two hungry families left for the city
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_family_los: Refugees - three died the night the dead broke in
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_home_refug: March Ridge church - a refuge that rings its bell on Sundays
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_home_basem: The basement of the March Ridge church
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_bio: A lay preacher who opened the March Ridge church to refugees. Speaks in a slow Kentucky drawl and quotes scripture now and then. Believes in charity and asks less than things are worth, but is quietly firm with anyone who threatens his flock.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_family: Doesn't talk about family. Lives with half-fixed cars
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_home_ark_: Her garage in Echo Creek - the Ark's engine turned over for the first time
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_home_ark: The Ark - dreaming of the day it leaves the county
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_home_shel: Her garage in Echo Creek - the Ark is shelved, she fixes other people's cars
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_bio: Lives in her Echo Creek garage surrounded by half-fixed cars. Gruff but kind, and swears first when things go wrong. Is building the 'Ark' out of three wrecks, a truck big enough to carry a dozen people out of the county. Likes people who keep their word and can fix things.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_family: Seven soldiers left in the squad
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_family_sq: Four soldiers left - fever and desertion took the rest
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_home_chec: The highway checkpoint - lets civilians through safely
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_home_fall: Knox Boundary Camp - fell back after a failed operation
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_bio: Leads what is left of a National Guard squad that hasn't heard from command in weeks, and keeps the watch schedule anyway. Terse, uses radio procedure, deeply suspicious of civilians and never careless with weapons or ammunition. Well armed, short on medicine and tools.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_rats_family: A crew of six - Dutch, the second, keeps pushing to rob survivors
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_rats_family_spl: The crew - half of them sided with Dutch
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_rats_family_tra: The crew - traders now, raiding less
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_rats_home: The old mining area near Coalfield (west of Fallas Lake)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_rats_bio: Leader of a scavenger crew calling themselves the Coalfield Crew. Sarcastic, greedy and practical. Has picked the county clean and has a bit of everything, for a price. Not a murderer over the radio, but always looking for an angle.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_family_d: Lost his dog to the bear and buried it by the creek
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_home: A cabin in the woods near Ekron
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_home_rea: A cabin in the woods near Ekron - ready for winter
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_home_lea: A cabin in the woods near Ekron - thinking about leaving the county
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_bio: A trapper who lived off the land in the Ekron woods long before the outbreak. Few words, suspicious of everyone. Knows rifles, knives, traps and dried meat, and has no patience for fools or talkers. Judges people by what they do, not what they say.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_1: I'm on the road to Louisville, sleeping in the pickup. The highway past Muldraugh is choked with wrecks and the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_2: A horde's drifting toward the highway and blocking the only road I can take. Can you thin them out from your side?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_3: Road cleared, and I made the edge of Louisville. The church shelter's somewhere in the city, and the city's full of the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_3x: The pickup got stuck and I walked the last miles into Louisville. Lost count of the days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_4: Found the church shelter where Annie stayed. The dead are all around it, and I'm nearly out of shells.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_5a: I found Annie! Alive, up in the shelter's bell tower. Walked her home to the farm. Sorry, I can't stop talking about her.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_5d: Annie's alive, and Dewey drove the Ark all the way to Louisville to bring us both home. I owe that woman everything.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_5x: The shelter fell weeks ago. They say Annie's group went south, your way... Someone saw a girl in a yellow raincoat among the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_6: My Annie... turned. She's wandering near you. I can't do it. Please, give her peace.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_7r: You gave Annie peace and brought back her ring. I buried it under the apple tree. I talk to her there in the evenings.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2a_7x: Nobody gave Annie peace. I'm going to find her myself. ...Take care of yourselves.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_1: A girl about ten turned up at the farm gate, alone and half starved. Says her name's Lily, and nothing else.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_2: Lily needs food, medicine, and something to make her smile. I've got nothing a child needs.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_3: Lily laughs now. Helps in the garden, calls me 'Mister Ray'. I feel ten years younger.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_3x: Lily's sick and barely eats. I sit up with her every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_4: A woman on the radio says she's Lily's mother and wants to meet at the March Ridge church. Hank says he's heard that voice riding with raiders.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_5a: She really was Lily's mother. Lily went with her, and they visit the farm on Sundays. Hurts more than I expected.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_5h: Hank was right. That 'mother' was raider bait. His warning shot scattered them, and Lily's staying with me for good.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray2b_5x: Nobody came to that meeting but raiders. They took Lily. ...I don't tend the garden anymore.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2a_1: Dad's back on his feet! So now I have a dream: a real relay station, so every survivor group in the county can hear each other.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2a_2: The relay needs an amplifier, wire and parts, and I don't have any of them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2a_3: The relay works! Three new groups check in every night, and I read their news on the evening broadcast.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2a_3x: The relay keeps burning out. It's frustrating, but I'll keep broadcasting with what I've got.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2a_4: Someone traced my signal. Last night a truck with no lights idled outside the shack for an hour. ...I'm scared.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2a_5a: The shack's safe and on the air every night. I named it 'Valley Station Free Radio'! People all over the county listen.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2a_5x: Raiders smashed the relay and took the batteries. Dad and I hid in the cellar. I only broadcast in whispers now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2b_1: A small voice answered my broadcast. A boy named Toby, about nine, alone in an attic with his little sister.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2b_2: Toby and his sister are running out of food and water. Could you please send them some?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2b_3: Toby says the food came! I read them stories over the radio every night until they fall asleep.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2b_3x: Toby's voice is getting weaker. I stay on the frequency all night, talking, so he's not alone.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2b_4: The dead have surrounded the house where Toby and his sister are hiding. They can't get out. Please help.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2b_5a: You got Toby and his sister out! They live with me in the shack now, and Toby reads the morning weather.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey2b_5x: Toby stopped answering. I still say goodnight to him on the air every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_1: Marcus, my best trainee, wears long sleeves in this heat and avoids me. Something's wrong.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_2: Everyone around the clinic is whispering, and I seem to be the only one who doesn't know. What is Marcus hiding?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_3a: I learned about Marcus's bite and tried everything. He died anyway, here, with me holding his hand. I'd rather have known.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_3p: Marcus went to Pike's church to die in peace. I sat with him at the end. I'm grateful to Pike, and angry at myself.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_3g: Whitaker's soldiers came and took Marcus away. I haven't forgiven anyone, myself included.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_3x: Marcus turned in the clinic at night and bit another patient before I stopped him. ...I don't sleep anymore.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_4: After Marcus, I want a proper isolation room, so it never happens again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_5a: The clinic has an isolation room and one rule: nobody hides a bite. My helpers trust me more than ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_5m: Dewey turned the back of the Ark into a mobile clinic. Twice a week I ride out to farms that can't come to me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2a_5x: I check everyone's arms at the door now. Some patients stopped coming. I let them go.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2b_1: ...I stopped answering at night. Pike says I sit alone in the dark clinic.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2b_2: I'm burned out. I need something, anything, to get through the nights.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2b_3: I slept a full night for the first time in a month. Pike came by and we talked until morning.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2b_3x: I packed half the clinic into boxes. I keep unpacking them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2b_4: If I reopen, I want to do it properly. Only with real supplies.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2b_5a: I reopened the clinic. It's smaller, but I'm back, and I tell everyone you talked me into it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc2b_5p: I closed the clinic and became the nurse at Pike's church. It's quieter there, and I sleep.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_1: Word of the refuge spread. Forty people sleep in the church now, and more come every day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_2: Forty mouths and an empty pantry. Will you help?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_3: The pantry holds for now. But crowds draw the dead. More of them at the fence every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_3x: Hunger split the refugees. Some of them say the church should close its doors.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_4: The church is overflowing. Whitaker wants to register everyone, Vic offers 'protection'... and I want to keep the doors open.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_5a: The second shelter stands. The church feeds sixty people, and the bell rings every Sunday. Thank you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_5g: The soldiers registered everyone and drafted the young men. The church is safe. Quieter than I'd like.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_5r: Vic's crew 'protects' the church now. Nobody steals from us, but a share of every meal goes to Coalfield.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2a_5x: The doors had to close. I turn people away every day. ...It's breaking me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2b_1: I haven't rung the bell since the night we lost three. I no longer know what to pray for.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2b_2: Ruth, who taught Sunday school, was one of the three. She walks among the dead now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2b_3: You laid Ruth to rest. I held the first funeral since the fall, and I sang.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2b_3x: Ruth still walks out there. Some nights I see her from the basement window.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2b_4: I want to fix the bell rope and board up the tower, so I can ring the bell again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2b_5a: I rang the bell again. People came out of hiding to listen, and I cried in front of all of them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike2b_5x: I took off my collar. I still look after the people in the basement, but I don't call myself a preacher anymore.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2a_1: I promised to drive the first group out of the county in the Ark. Six folks from the farms near Echo Creek.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2a_2: Before the first run the Ark needs spare tires and tools.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2a_3: The Ark's loaded and ready. Test-drove it to the county line and back, singing the whole way!
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2a_3x: A tire blew on the test run and the Ark nearly rolled. Damn it. Patching it with whatever I've got.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2a_4: A horde's gathered right across the convoy road. Even the Ark can't push through that many.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2a_5a: We made it! Drove six people past the county line and came back for more. They call the Ark 'the ferry' now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2a_5x: The Ark went into the ditch with everyone inside. Two of them... didn't get out. Don't ask me about the Ark.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_1: Somebody broke into the garage and took the Ark's engine block. The one part I can't replace! Vic's boys were seen nearby.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_2: I want my engine back. Vic says he 'found' it and he'll sell it to me. Unbelievable.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_3a: Walked into Coalfield with you and took my engine back. Vic's sulking, and I can't stop grinning.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_3r: Paid Vic for my own engine. It's back in the garage, and I'm still swearing about it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_3g: Whitaker's soldiers raided Coalfield and brought my engine back. Vic's furious with everyone.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_3x: The engine's gone for good. I sold the Ark's frame for parts. ...I've gotten quiet, huh?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_4: Got the engine back. This time I'm finishing the Ark for real.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_5a: The Ark runs at last! Two tries and one theft. That's what makes it a real Kentucky truck.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey2b_5x: Ran out of parts again. The engine sits on a stand in the garage. ...Some nights I polish it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_1: A voice claiming to be battalion command broke weeks of silence on our channel. The authentication codes are half familiar.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_2: Orders from command: close the checkpoint to civilians and burn the refugee camp beside it as an infection risk. I have not answered.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_3: I have to answer command. Casey says the signal is fake. Pike begs me to refuse.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_4f: Casey traced the 'command' signal. A raider band with a stolen military radio. I was a fool. ...I am furious.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_4p: I refused the order and sent the camp's people to Pike's church. Two of my soldiers called me a traitor and left.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_4o: I sealed the checkpoint. The refugees burned their own shelters and walked away. My squad won't meet my eyes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_4x: We never sealed the checkpoint, and command went silent again. I do not know if I am relieved.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_5: The noise at the checkpoint drew a horde. It is moving toward the camp. Requesting support.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_6a: The checkpoint holds. I no longer wait for orders. ...This is our county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_6f: The raiders' radio is smashed and the checkpoint held. I trust Casey's ears over any voice claiming rank.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2a_6x: The horde broke the checkpoint. Pulling out north with whoever is left. Out.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_1: Privates Cole and Mendez, my deserters, turned up working for Vic's crew. ...Nothing more to say.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_2: I want my deserters back to face discipline. Vic won't hand them over, and Ray found one hiding at his farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_3a: Cole came back on his own. I put him on latrine duty and said nothing else. The squad noticed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_3r: One of them is hiding at Ray's farm, and Ray will not give him up. I am not speaking to Ray.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_3v: Both deserters stayed with Vic. Now Vic knows our watch schedule.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_3x: The deserters vanished. I doubled the watch. I sleep in my boots.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_4: The camp is down to four soldiers. We need to fortify before winter.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_5a: The camp is fortified, and the four of us hold it. I have started letting civilians trade at the gate.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard2b_5x: The camp cannot be held. Walking north with the last of the squad. Out.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2a_1: A Louisville gang, the Iron Horse, sent word. Coalfield's theirs now, and my trading post owes them half.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2a_2: To tell the Iron Horse to get lost, I need guns.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2a_3: Turned the Iron Horse riders away at the bridge with every gun showing. They said they'd be back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2a_3x: Paid the Iron Horse a tribute to buy time. The crew thinks I've gone soft.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2a_4: The Iron Horse are driving the dead ahead of their attack, and the herd's coming through your side. Break it up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2a_5a: The Iron Horse broke on my barricades. My trading post is the strongest thing in the south county. Real businessman now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2a_5x: The Iron Horse are at the barricades. I'm not running.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_1: I call on a different frequency now. Dutch runs the crew like a warlord. Three of my old boys want me back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_2: My loyal boys need weapons before I move on Dutch.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_3: My boys are armed. I've set the night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_3x: One of my boys talked. Dutch knows something's coming.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_4: Tonight I take the crew back from Dutch. Or die trying.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_5a: I'm the boss again. Dutch is gone, the crew's smaller and quieter, and it's staying that way.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_5g: The soldiers are raiding Coalfield. Dutch is finished, and so am I here. Heading south.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats2b_5x: Dutch knows. I'm going in anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_1: Found a notebook in the dead hiker's pack. He was walking home to a wife and son.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_2: The hiker's house is in your part of the county. Thick with the dead. Clear it and I'll see if the family's there.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_3: House was empty. Note on the door: 'Gone to the March Ridge church.' I'll walk the notebook there myself.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_3x: Couldn't get near the house. I read his notebook at night instead. ...Feels like I knew him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_4: Walking a dead man's notebook to his family. Need supplies for the trip.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_5a: Found the hiker's wife and gave her the notebook. She sends me a jar of preserves every month. ...Don't care.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_5c: The family was safe at Pike's church. I stayed for supper. Haven't done that with anyone in years.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2a_5x: Never found the family. The notebook stays on the shelf by the door.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2b_1: Packing to leave the county. One thing left before I go. Taking up the trap lines.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2b_2: Need a good knife and rope to take up the traps.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2b_3: Traps are up. Walked the lines one last time. ...Caught myself thinking about staying.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2b_3x: Left half the traps in the snow. Angry about it. Means I care, I suppose.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2b_4: If the cabin had an axe for firewood and enough food stored, I'd stay one more winter.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2b_5a: I stayed. Only for one more winter. ...Everyone knows it isn't.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter2b_5x: I'm leaving. Cabin key's under the stone by the door. It's yours.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_lily: A woman on Casey's frequency says she is the mother of Lily, the girl at Ray's farm, and wants to meet at the March Ridge church. Hank says he has heard that voice riding with raiders.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_lily_ray: Wants shotgun shells so he can take Lily to the meeting himself.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_lily_pike: Asks for blankets and food so the church can host the meeting safely.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_lily_hunter: Thinks it's a trap and wants rifle ammunition to watch from the treeline.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_trace: Someone traced Casey's broadcast to her radio shack in Valley Station. A truck with no lights idled outside for an hour last night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_trace_casey: Wants shotgun shells to defend the shack herself.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_trace_guard: Will post two soldiers at the shack if given 5.56 ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_trace_hunter: Will find the truck's camp and deal with it quietly if given rifle ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_marcus: Marcus, the nurse June trained, has been hiding a bite. June doesn't know yet. The clinic is at risk if nobody acts.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_marcus_doc: Tell June, and bring antibiotics and painkillers so she can try to treat him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_marcus_pike: Asks for blankets and candles so Marcus can spend his last days in peace at the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_marcus_guard: Will take Marcus away and deal with it if given 5.56 ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_doors: Pike's church is overflowing. Whitaker wants to register and draft everyone, Vic offers 'protection' for a cut of the food, and Pike wants to keep the doors open.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_doors_pike: Needs planks and nails to build a second shelter so the doors can stay open.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_doors_guard: Wants 5.56 ammunition to arm the refugees he will register and draft.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_doors_rats: Wants whiskey and cigarettes as the first payment for 'protecting' the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_engine: The engine block of Dewey's Ark was stolen. Vic says his crew 'found' it and will sell it back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_engine_dewey: Wants a crowbar and shotgun shells to take the engine back from Coalfield.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_engine_rats: Will 'sell' Dewey her engine back for whiskey and cigarettes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_engine_guard: Will raid Coalfield and recover the engine if given 5.56 ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_orders: Whitaker got orders from a voice claiming to be battalion command: close the checkpoint and burn the refugee camp. Casey thinks the signal is fake. Pike begs him to refuse.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_orders_guard: Needs 5.56 ammunition to seal the checkpoint as ordered.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_orders_casey: Wants batteries and an amplifier to trace the 'command' signal and prove it fake.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_orders_pike: Asks for food and blankets so the church can take in the camp's refugees.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_deserters: Two of Whitaker's deserters work for Vic now. Whitaker wants them back for discipline, Vic wants to keep them, and Ray found the younger one hiding at his farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_deserters_guard: Needs 5.56 ammunition to make Vic hand the deserters over.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_deserters_rats: Wants shotgun shells; the two soldiers stay with his crew.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_deserters_ray: Asks for food and blankets so he can keep hiding the scared young soldier.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_dutch: Vic plans to take his old crew back from Dutch tonight. Hank wants Dutch's snares off his land, and Whitaker would rather see the whole crew gone.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_dutch_rats: Needs shotgun shells for the fight with Dutch.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_dutch_hunter: Will cover Vic from the treeline if given rifle ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_dutch_guard: Will raid Coalfield and arrest the whole crew if given two boxes of 5.56.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_family_reun: Daughter Annie - found again, living with him on the farm
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_family_sear: Daughter Annie - the shelter fell; she went south, they say
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_family_rest: Daughter Annie - at rest, her ring buried under the farm's apple tree
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_family_lily: Looking after Lily, a lost girl (no word of his daughter Annie)
Lily - went home with her mother, visits on Sundays
Lily - as good as his daughter now
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_ray_home_farm_a: The farm outside West Point - with Annie
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_family_to: Her father died. She looks after Toby and his sister over the radio
Toby and his sister - living with her in the shack
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_home_stat: Valley Station Free Radio (her father's shack)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_home_cell: The shack's cellar in Valley Station - broadcasting in whispers
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_casey_home_shac: The Valley Station shack - with Toby and his sister
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_home_isolat: Riverside clinic - now with an isolation room
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_home_mobile: Riverside clinic and the Ark's mobile clinic
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_doc_home_church: March Ridge church - the church's nurse
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_home_town: March Ridge church - a small town of sixty now
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_home_camp: March Ridge church - a camp run by the soldiers
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_pike_home_bell: March Ridge church - the bell rings again
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_home_ferr: The Ark - 'the ferry' carrying people out of the county
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_home_wrec: Echo Creek garage - the Ark went into a ditch
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_home_sold: Echo Creek garage - the Ark's frame sold for parts
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_dewey_home_engi: Echo Creek garage - the Ark's engine on a stand
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_family_sq: What's left of the squad - two left when he refused orders
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_family_de: Four soldiers left - two deserters now ride with Vic
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_guard_home_fort: Knox boundary camp - fortified, trading at the gate
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_rats_family_pos: The crew - the strongest trading post in the south county
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_rats_family_reg: The crew - taken back from Dutch
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_family_h: The dead hiker's family - sends him preserves every month
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_home_sta: His cabin in the Ekron woods - staying 'one more winter'
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_annie_desc: Ray's daughter. Wore a yellow raincoat and the silver ring her mother left her. Student clothes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_ruth_desc: Sunday school teacher at Pike's church. Always wore her grandmother's gold necklace. Teacher's clothes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_People_Asking: Asking for help with this story right now (quest tab [Story] / [Crisis])
IGUI_StoryEngine_People_StoryOver: This person's main story has ended
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_1: Every evening Ray went through his notebook of frequencies, hoping to reach his daughter Annie in Louisville.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_2: When his garden finally came in, Ray talked about planting extra for when Annie came home.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_3: One night Ray heard a faint woman's voice that might have come from Louisville. He asked us for batteries to keep listening.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_4a: Thanks to what we brought, Ray caught the voice again. It was Annie, alive in a church shelter in Louisville.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_4t: Because we sided with Ray at the overturned truck, its food fed his neighbors for a week, and they promised to watch the farm while he went to Louisville.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_4b: The batteries never reached him and the voice was lost. Ray blamed himself and started drinking at night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_5: Ray fixed up his old pickup to go get Annie, but the battery was dead. He asked us for a car battery.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_5b: Ray wanted one more try at reaching Louisville, but his radio needed parts to reach that far.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_6a: The battery we found started the pickup. Ray set off for Louisville to find Annie, radioing in from the road.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_6b: The pickup never started. Ray stayed on the farm, tending the garden for a daughter he might never see.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray_end_bad: There was no way left to reach Louisville. Ray talked less and sometimes left his radio off for days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_1: Casey's father had been coughing for days, with a fever every night. Between broadcasts she read medical books.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_2: As her father's fever kept climbing, Casey asked us for medicine and water.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_3a: The medicine we sent brought the fever down a little. Braver now, Casey started building a bigger antenna on the roof.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_3b: No medicine came and her father got worse. Casey barely slept and kept the radio on just to hear another voice.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_4s: Because we helped Casey when the strange signal came, her boosted rig reached survivors in Brandenburg. She talked to them every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_4x: While we helped someone else, the strange signal went silent. Casey tried not to show how hurt she was.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_4: Her father's cough turned into a chest infection. Casey said she needed real medicine now: antibiotics.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_4b: Her father was fighting for breath. Terrified, Casey begged anyone who would listen for medicine.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_5a: The antibiotics we found saved her father. Casey taught him Morse code at his bedside.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey_5b: The medicine came too late and Casey's father died. She kept broadcasting so nobody else would feel alone.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_1: June's clinic had four patients, including a boy with a broken leg who asked every morning when he could walk.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_2: To set the boy's leg properly June needed splints and bandages, and she asked us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_3a: With the splints we brought, the leg was set. The boy walked on a crutch, and June laughed for the first time in weeks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_3b: No splints came and the leg healed crooked. The boy would limp for life, and June was bitter about how little she had.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_4f: When the fever swept through, we helped June, and nobody in her clinic died. She would not stop saying so.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_4x: When the fever came we sent the medicine elsewhere, and one of June's patients died. She went cold and quiet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_4: A stranger stumbled into the clinic with a deep gash, and June had nothing left to close it. She asked us for help.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_5a: With the suture kit we found, the stranger lived. The clinic found its feet; June trained recovered patients as helpers and began to sleep a little.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc_5b: The stranger died. June talked about closing the clinic, and she sounded exhausted.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_1: Twelve refugees slept in Brother Pike's church. When a quarrel broke out over rations, he stepped between two men.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_2: The church pantry was nearly empty, and Pike asked us for food for the children.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_3a: The food we sent filled the church. A garden started behind it, and people sang while they worked.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_3b: No food came, and two hungry families left for the city. Pike prayed for them every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_4r: When Vic's crew planned to hit the church, we kept it safe, and they never got in. Pike's people called us friends.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_4x: When the raid came we sided with Vic, and the storeroom was emptied. Pike forgave them, but his people were frightened.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_4: After a night of the dead pressing on the church doors, Pike asked us for nails and a hammer to board the windows.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_5a: With the nails and hammer we sent, the windows were boarded. The church became a true refuge, and its Sunday bell drew people from miles around.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike_5b: The windows stayed open, and one night the dead broke in. Three people died. Pike blamed himself and moved everyone to the basement.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_1: Dewey was building a truck she called the Ark out of three wrecks, big enough to carry a dozen people out of the county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_2: The Ark's engine needed parts Dewey could not find, so she asked us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_3a: With the parts we found, the Ark's engine turned over for the first time. Dewey whooped so loud the dead came to the fence.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_3b: No parts came and the engine seized. Dewey swore about it constantly; it set her back weeks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_4s: When the strange signal came we backed Dewey, and the relay tower's wire gave the Ark lights and a radio. It looked like a real rescue truck.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_4: Before the Ark could leave the garage, it needed a battery and armor plating.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_5a: With the battery and plating we found, the Ark ran. Dewey gave rides and dreamed out loud of a convoy out of the county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey_5b: The Ark was shelved. Dewey fixed other people's cars instead, grumbling, but she still talked about it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_1: Sergeant Whitaker's squad was down to seven. Command had been silent for weeks, but he kept the watch schedule anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_2: Two privates were overheard talking about deserting. Whitaker put them on double watch and said nothing more.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_3: A fever spread through the camp and the aid kit was empty. Whitaker asked us for antibiotics.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_4a: The antibiotics we sent beat the fever. The squad was loyal again, and Whitaker grudgingly admitted civilians had come through.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_4b: No medicine came. One soldier died of the fever and two deserted in the night. Whitaker was stone-faced.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_4t: We sided with Whitaker at the overturned truck, and its military cargo restocked the camp. He began planning to clear the highway checkpoint.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_5: Whitaker asked us for ammunition and dressings for the operation to clear the highway checkpoint.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_6a: With the ammunition we sent, the squad cleared the checkpoint. Whitaker let civilians through safely and sounded almost proud.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard_6b: The operation failed and the squad fell back to camp. Whitaker was more closed off than ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_1: Vic's crew was six people. His second, Dutch, kept pushing to rob survivors instead of scavenging.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_2: Dutch took two men out on a 'job' without asking Vic. Vic pretended not to care.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_3: Payday was coming and the crew was restless. Vic asked us for shotgun shells to keep them loyal.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_4a: With the shells we found, Vic kept the crew in line. Dutch sulked in a corner.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_4b: No shells came, and Dutch challenged Vic openly. Half the crew listened to him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_4r: When the church raid came we sided with Vic. The job paid off, the crew loved him again, and Dutch went quiet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_5: To prove he was still the boss, Vic planned to crack the Coalfield bank vault. He asked us for a crowbar and a sledgehammer.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_6a: With the tools we found, the vault opened. Nobody could touch Vic now, and he started turning the crew into traders.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats_6b: The vault stayed shut and Dutch took over the crew. Vic still called sometimes, but his voice was lower and the crew more dangerous.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_1: A big black bear kept raiding Hank's trap lines, and he was tracking it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_2: Hank found a dead hiker in the woods and buried him. He said nothing more about it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_3: The bear hurt Hank's dog. He meant to finish it and asked us for rifle ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_4a: With the rounds we sent, Hank got the bear. Smoked meat for weeks, and he almost smiled telling it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_4b: No rounds came, and the bear killed Hank's dog. He buried it by the creek and grew colder than ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_4s: When the strange signal came we helped Hank. He scouted the tower himself; it was bandit bait, and he told only us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_5: Winter would come early in the woods. Hank asked us for a knife and twine to set new trap lines.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_6a: With the knife and twine we sent, Hank was ready for winter. He called us 'neighbor' now, which is a lot, coming from him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter_6b: His winter preparations failed. Hank started thinking about leaving the county for good.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_1: Ray drove toward Louisville, sleeping in the pickup. The highway past Muldraugh was choked with wrecks and the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_2: A horde drifted onto the only road Ray could take, and he asked us to thin it out from our side.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_3: We cleared the horde and the road opened. Ray reached the edge of Louisville, a city full of the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_3x: The road stayed blocked. Ray left the pickup and walked the last miles into Louisville.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_4: Ray found the church shelter where Annie had stayed, surrounded by the dead. He needed shells and dressings to get in.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_5a: With the shells we sent, Ray got inside and found Annie in the bell tower. They walked home to the farm together.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_5d: Ray found Annie in the shelter's bell tower, and Dewey drove the Ark all the way to Louisville to bring them both home.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_5x: The shelter had fallen weeks before. Annie's group had fled south, toward us, and someone had seen a girl in a yellow raincoat among the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_6: Annie had turned and was wandering near us. Ray could not do it himself and asked us to give her peace.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_7r: We gave Annie peace and brought back her silver ring. Ray buried it under the apple tree, and he talks to her there in the evenings.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2a_7x: Nobody gave Annie peace. Ray drove off alone to find his daughter himself.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_1: A girl of about ten turned up alone and half starved at Ray's gate. She said her name was Lily, and nothing more.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_2: Ray had nothing a child needs and asked us for food, medicine and something to make her smile.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_3: With what we sent, Lily began to laugh. She helped in the garden and called him 'Mister Ray'.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_3x: Nothing came, and Lily fell sick. Ray sat up with her every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_4: A woman on the radio said she was Lily's mother and wanted to meet at the March Ridge church. Hank said the voice rode with raiders. We had to choose whom to help.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_5a: The woman at the meeting really was Lily's mother. Lily went with her, and they visit the farm on Sundays.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_5h: We trusted Hank. The 'mother' was raider bait, his warning shot scattered them, and Lily stayed with Ray.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray2b_5x: Only raiders came to the meeting. They took Lily, and Ray stopped tending the garden.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2a_1: With her father back on his feet, Casey dreamed of a real relay so every survivor group in the county could hear each other.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2a_2: The relay needed an amplifier, wire and parts, and Casey asked us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2a_3: With the parts we found, the relay worked. Three new groups checked in every night, and Casey read their news on the evening broadcast.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2a_3x: No parts came and the relay kept burning out. Casey kept broadcasting with what she had.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2a_4: Someone traced Casey's signal; a truck with no lights idled outside her shack for an hour. We had to choose who would protect her.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2a_5a: The shack was safe, and Casey broadcasts 'Valley Station Free Radio' every night. People all over the county listen.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2a_5x: Raiders smashed the relay and took the batteries. Casey and her father hid in the cellar, and she broadcasts only in whispers now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2b_1: A small voice answered Casey's broadcast: Toby, about nine, alone in an attic with his little sister.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2b_2: The children were running out of food and water, and Casey asked us to send some.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2b_3: The food we sent reached them. Every night Casey read the two of them stories until they fell asleep.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2b_3x: No food reached them and Toby's voice grew weaker. Casey stayed on the frequency all night, talking to him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2b_4: The dead surrounded the house where the children were hiding, and Casey begged us to clear them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2b_5a: We cleared the dead and brought Toby and his sister out. They live in Casey's shack now, and Toby reads the morning weather.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey2b_5x: We never broke through, and Toby stopped answering. Casey still says goodnight to him on the air every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_1: Marcus, June's best trainee, wore long sleeves in the heat and avoided her.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_2: Marcus was hiding a bite, and only June did not know. We had to decide whom to turn to.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_3a: We told June and brought her medicine. She tried everything, but Marcus died in the clinic holding her hand.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_3p: We sent Marcus to Pike's church. He spent his last days in peace, with June beside him at the end.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_3g: We left it to Whitaker, and his soldiers took Marcus away. June forgave no one.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_3x: Nobody acted. Marcus turned in the clinic at night and bit another patient, and June stopped sleeping.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_4: June wanted an isolation room so it would never happen again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_5a: With the materials we found, the clinic got its isolation room. Under one rule, nobody hides a bite, the helpers trusted June more than ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_5m: The clinic got its isolation room, and Dewey turned the back of the Ark into a mobile clinic. Twice a week June rides out to distant farms.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2a_5x: There was no isolation room. June checks everyone's arms at the door now, and lets the patients who stop coming go.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2b_1: June stopped answering at night. Pike said she sat alone in the dark clinic.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2b_2: Burned out, June said she needed something to get through the nights.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2b_3: With what we sent, June slept a full night for the first time in a month. Pike came by and they talked until morning.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2b_3x: June packed half the clinic into boxes, and kept unpacking them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2b_4: June said she would reopen only if she could do it properly, with real supplies.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2b_5a: With the supplies we found, June reopened the clinic. It is smaller, but she tells everyone we talked her into coming back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc2b_5p: June closed the clinic and became the nurse at Pike's church. It is quieter there, and she sleeps.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_1: Word of the refuge spread. Forty people slept in the church, and more came every day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_2: The pantry could not feed forty, and Pike asked us for food.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_3: The food we sent kept the pantry going. But crowds draw the dead, and more of them came to the fence each night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_3x: No food came, and hunger split the refugees. Some said the doors should close.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_4: The church overflowed. Whitaker wanted to register everyone, Vic offered 'protection', and Pike wanted the doors open. It was up to us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_5a: With the planks and nails we sent, a second shelter went up. The church feeds sixty people, and the bell rings every Sunday.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_5g: We backed Whitaker. His soldiers registered everyone and drafted the young men. The church is safe, and quiet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_5r: We chose Vic's 'protection'. Nobody steals from the church, but a share of every meal goes to Coalfield.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2a_5x: No shelter was built and the doors closed. Pike turns people away every day, and it is breaking him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2b_1: Pike had not rung the bell since the night three died. He said he no longer knew what to pray for.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2b_2: Ruth, the Sunday school teacher, one of the three, walked among the dead. Pike asked us to lay her to rest.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2b_3: We laid Ruth to rest. Pike held his first funeral since the fall, and he sang.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2b_3x: Ruth still walks out there. Some nights Pike sees her from the basement window.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike2b_4: Pike wanted to fix the bell rope and board up the tower so he could ring the bell again.
