IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_offer_1: I can give you this. It'll serve.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_chat_checkin: Caught a rabbit today. Just wanted to say.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_chat_evening: Sun's down. Keep your fire going.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Named_tony_desc: Vic's little brother, missing since the first week. Wore Vic's old black jacket with the torn sleeve. Biker clothes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Profile_hunter_family_c: Earl's son Caleb lives at the cabin with him
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec_Error_hurt: Hurt in their story and cannot help right now
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_1a: Spring on the farm. I'm strong again and itching to plant more than ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_1b: Spring on the farm. I tire fast since winter, but the ground's soft and I want to plant.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_2: Thinking about what the farm should be. The county's farm, open to anyone who works it, or a family farm I can hand on.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_3: Pike wants it shared, Vic wants it traded, Whitaker wants it rationed. Everybody wants my farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_4p: Opened the farm to Pike's people. Anyone who works it eats. The fields are loud with folks now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_4r: The harvest trades at Vic's market. Folks eat, Vic gets his cut, I get seed and tools.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_4g: The squad rations the harvest county-wide. Fair, dull, and nobody goes hungry.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_4n: Nobody could agree, so the farm stays mine. A family farm, small and stubborn.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_5: Planting season. I need seed and tools for the spring sowing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_6a: The county's farm is planted. Kids run the rows, and I sit on the porch telling trucker stories to anyone who stops.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_6fa: Handed the farm to Annie. She runs it better than I did, and I tell her so every day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_6fl: Lily planted her own row this spring and told the scarecrow it works for her now. The farm'll be hers one day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_6f: A small farm, planted with my own two hands. Enough for me, and a little more for the neighbors.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ray5_6x: No seed came. Planted what I'd saved and it came up thin. I'm tired. Talking about retiring.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_1a: Spring at the clinic. My apprentice runs the morning line without me now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_1b: Spring at the clinic. I can't stop thinking about Rosa, but the baby is thriving.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_2: My apprentice is ready to be more than a helper. I want him to become a real medic. The exam: a real operation, under my eye.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_3: His first operation needs proper instruments, not the clinic's worn ones.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_4: He did it. A clean operation, steady hands. I cried in the supply room after. Now he wants to open a second clinic in Rosewood.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_4x: With worn instruments it went badly, though the patient lived. He doubts himself now. I'm trying to fix that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_5: The building for the second clinic in Rosewood is full of the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_6a: There are two clinics in the county now. My apprentice runs Rosewood and calls me for advice every night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_6b: The second clinic opened, small and nervous. He'll grow into it. I did.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_doc5_6x: The second clinic never opened. He stayed with me, and we're both still alone with too many patients.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_1a: Spring, and the roads are open. Kids keep showing up asking to learn engines.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_1b: Spring. I'm back in the garage, slower than before. Kids keep showing up asking to learn engines.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_2: Decided to teach them properly. A garage school. They need their own tools.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_3: The garage school needs tools for the kids.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_4: School runs every morning. The kids want to build a second vehicle: a bus that loops the county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_4x: The kids share one wrench and argue about it. They still want to build a bus.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_5: The bus needs a battery and engine parts before its first run.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_6a: The county bus runs a weekly loop: farms, church, clinic, market. The kids drive. I ride in back yelling advice.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_6b: The bus runs, slow and loud. The kids are proud and so am I. Won't say it, though.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dewey5_6x: The bus never ran. The school still meets, and someday it will. I keep telling them that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_1: Spring. The squad wintered in the county, and the county is starting to feel like the mission.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_2: Thinking of turning the squad into a county guard. Soldiers and volunteers together, answering to the people, not to orders that never come.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_3: To arm a county guard properly, the volunteers need sidearm ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_4: The county guard is armed. First patrol tomorrow. The route is thick with the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_4x: Half-armed volunteers and tired soldiers. First patrol tomorrow. The route is thick with the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_5: The county guard's first patrol has run into a group of the dead. Requesting support.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_6a: The county guard is real. I gave my last salute as a sergeant and took off the stripes. I still wear the boots.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_6b: The county guard held its first patrol, green and shaky. It will do. I am staying to teach them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guard5_6x: The first patrol went badly. The squad scattered to their families. I kept the radio and a handful of the loyal.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_1a: Spring market days are big again. I walk the stalls like a mayor. I hate how much I like it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_1b: Spring. Quit drinking, mostly. The market's coming back, slow.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_2: People want someone to keep the peace in the south county. They keep saying my name.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_3: Should I be sheriff? Pike says stay a trader. Whitaker wants to share the job.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_4a: I took it. Sheriff Vic. First case: a pack of the dead blocking the crossroads.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_4g: Sharing the peacekeeping with Whitaker's people. Awkward, and it works. Neither of us will admit it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_4p: Stayed a trader, like Pike said. Honest trade turned out to be its own kind of peacekeeping.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_4n: Nobody decided, so I keep doing what I do. Keeping the market fair. Mostly.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_5: First job as sheriff. The dead are blocking the crossroads to the market.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_6a: Sheriff Vic. People nod at me on the road. My old crew salutes me as a joke, and I let them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_6b: First job went bad and people are already muttering. Still sheriff. For now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rats5_6x: It all fell through, and I went back to the old ways for a while. Not proud of it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_1a: Spring in the woods. Not alone in the cabin. The deer are back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_1b: Spring in the woods. Snow's gone. Cabin's too quiet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_2: Farm kids keep asking me to teach them trapping. Said no. They keep coming back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_3: If I'm teaching them, they need proper knives and twine.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_4: The school of the woods meets at dawn. They're terrible. They're getting better.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_4x: The kids share one knife. I teach what I can with what we have.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_5: A group of the dead wandered into the woods during a lesson. Near the kids.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_6a: Six kids can set a snare and read a track now. They call me 'neighbor' too. Staying in the woods was never really a question.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_6b: The lessons go on, one knife at a time. The woods are less lonely with kids crashing through them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunter5_6x: A kid got hurt when the dead came. I stopped the lessons. Went quiet in the woods again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey5_1: Spring on the air. Pike and I keep talking about getting everyone on the radio together for a real county meeting.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey5_2: Pike and I called the first county council since the fall! I'll broadcast it from the church, and everyone's invited.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey5_3: The day before the council, the dead are gathering around the church. I'm scared it'll all fall apart.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey5_9a: The county council met and I broadcast every word. They agreed to meet every month. I said 'This is Valley Station, signing off' and cried.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_casey5_9b: The council broke up in shouting, live on my broadcast. I keep thinking about what I should've said.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike5_1: Spring at the church. Casey and I keep talking about bringing the whole county together, on the radio, in one room.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike5_2: Casey and I called the first county council at the church. We need food, candles, batteries and blankets for everyone who comes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike5_3: The day before the council, the dead are gathering around the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike5_9a: The county council met in our church. Farmers, soldiers, traders, the nurse, the trapper. They'll meet again next month. I rang the bell.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pike5_9b: The council broke up in arguments under our roof. I swept up after and prayed it was only the first try.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_1a: Spring came, and Ray, strong again, wanted to plant more than ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_1b: Spring came. Ray tired quickly but wanted his hands in the soil again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_2: Ray weighed opening the farm to the county against keeping it a family farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_3: Pike, Vic and Whitaker each wanted Ray's farm, and we had to choose.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_4p: We helped Pike. The farm opened to anyone who worked it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_4r: We helped Vic. The harvest trades at his market.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_4g: We helped Whitaker. The squad rations the harvest county-wide.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_4n: Nothing was settled, and the farm stayed Ray's family farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_5: Ray asked for seed and tools for the spring sowing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_6a: With the seed we sent, the county's farm was planted. Ray tells trucker stories on the porch.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_6fa: With the seed we sent, the sowing was done, and Ray handed the farm to Annie.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_6fl: With the seed we sent, the sowing was done. Lily planted her own row; one day the farm will be hers.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_6f: With the seed we sent, Ray planted his small family farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ray5_6x: No seed came. Looking at the thin fields, Ray talked of retiring.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_1a: Spring came, and the apprentice ran the morning line without June.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_1b: Spring came. June could not forget Rosa, but the baby thrived.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_2: June wanted to make her apprentice a real medic. The exam would be a real operation.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_3: June asked for proper instruments for his first operation.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_4: With the instruments we sent, the apprentice succeeded, and he wanted to open a second clinic in Rosewood.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_4x: No instruments came, and the operation with worn tools went badly.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_5: The building for the second clinic was full of the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_6a: We cleared the building. The county has two clinics now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_6b: We cleared the building, and a small second clinic opened.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_doc5_6x: The building stayed overrun, and the second clinic never opened.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_1a: When spring came, kids came to Dewey to learn engines.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_1b: Spring came, and even with her bad leg, kids came to Dewey to learn engines.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_2: Dewey decided to open a garage school.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_3: Dewey asked for tools for the kids.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_4: With the tools we sent, the school ran, and the kids wanted to build a bus to loop the county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_4x: No tools came. The kids dreamed of a bus with one wrench between them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_5: The bus needed a battery and engine parts.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_6a: With the parts we sent, the county bus runs a weekly loop, driven by the kids.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_6b: With the parts we sent, the bus runs, slow and loud.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dewey5_6x: No parts came and the bus never ran. The school goes on.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_1: Spring came, and the county was becoming the squad's mission.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_2: Whitaker thought about turning the squad into a county guard.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_3: Whitaker asked for sidearm ammunition for the volunteers.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_4: With the ammunition we sent, the county guard was armed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_4x: No ammunition came, and they prepared for the first patrol half armed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_5: The first patrol ran into a group of the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_6a: With us there, the first patrol held. Whitaker gave his last salute and took off his stripes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_6b: With us there, the first patrol held. Whitaker stayed on to teach them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guard5_6x: The patrol broke, and the squad scattered.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_1a: Spring market days grew again, and Vic walked the stalls like a mayor.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_1b: Spring came. Vic drank less, and the market slowly came back.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_2: People wanted Vic to keep the peace in the south county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_3: Whether Vic would become sheriff was up to us.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_4a: We backed Vic. Sheriff Vic's first case was the dead at the crossroads.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_4g: We backed Whitaker. Vic and the soldiers share the peacekeeping.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_4p: We backed Pike. Vic stayed an honest trader.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_4n: Nothing was decided, and Vic kept the market as before.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_5: As his first job as sheriff, Vic asked us to clear the crossroads.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_6a: We cleared the crossroads. People nod at Sheriff Vic now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_6b: The crossroads stayed blocked, and people mutter.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rats5_6x: It all fell through, and Vic went back to the old ways for a while.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_1a: Spring came, and Hank's cabin was not lonely.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_1b: Spring came, and the cabin was too quiet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_2: Farm kids wanted Hank to teach them to hunt.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_3: Hank asked for knives and twine for the kids.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_4: With what we sent, the school of the woods met every dawn.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_4x: Nothing came. The kids shared one knife.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_5: During a lesson, a group of the dead wandered into the woods near the kids.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_6a: We cleared the dead. Six kids can set snares and read tracks now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_6b: We cleared the dead. The lessons go on, one knife at a time.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunter5_6x: The dead stayed, a child was hurt, and Hank stopped the lessons.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey5_1: On the spring broadcasts, Casey and Pike talked about a county meeting.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey5_2: Casey and Pike called the first county council, and we helped prepare.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey5_3: The day before the council, the dead gathered around the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey5_9a: The county council met and agreed to meet every month. Casey broadcast every word.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_casey5_9b: The council broke up in shouting, live on Casey's broadcast.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike5_1: Pike and Casey talked of bringing the whole county together.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike5_2: The first county council would be held in Pike's church, and we helped prepare.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike5_3: The day before the council, the dead gathered around the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike5_9a: The county council met in Pike's church, and Pike rang the bell.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pike5_9b: The council ended in arguments, and Pike prayed for a next time.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_commons: Ray is deciding what his farm should be. Pike wants it shared with the church, Vic wants it traded at his market, Whitaker wants it rationed by the squad, and Ray half wants a family farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_commons_ray: Wants planks and nails to fence it and keep a family farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_commons_pike: Asks for canned food so the church can feed people working Ray's fields.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_commons_rats: Wants twine and sacks so his market can carry Ray's harvest.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_commons_guard: Will guard the fields and ration the harvest for a box of 9mm rounds.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_sheriff: People in the south county want Vic as sheriff. Whitaker would rather share the job with his soldiers, and Pike thinks Vic should stay an honest trader.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_sheriff_rats: Wants shotgun shells to arm his deputies.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_sheriff_guard: Will share the peacekeeping with Vic for 5.56 ammunition.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Crisis_sheriff_pike: Asks for food so Vic's market can keep feeding people as honest trade.
IGUI_StoryEngine_QTitle_council_horde: Guard the church before the council
IGUI_StoryEngine_Council_Header: County council - the first one, called by Valley Station and the March Ridge church
IGUI_StoryEngine_Council_Notice_collect: A county council is coming - help prepare (quest tab)
IGUI_StoryEngine_Council_Notice_horde: The dead are gathering at the church before the council
IGUI_StoryEngine_Council_Notice_done_for: The county council formed - it will meet every month
IGUI_StoryEngine_Council_Notice_done_fai: The county council broke up in arguments
IGUI_StoryEngine_Chron_council_formed: Held the county council - it will meet every month

IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep1_1: A stray dog followed me home from the fields. Won't leave.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep1_1: A stray dog followed Ray home to the farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep1_2: The dog stayed. Named it Trucker. Sleeps by the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep1_2: The dog stayed, and Ray named it Trucker.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep2_1: Big Lou, my old trucking buddy, came on the radio from Louisville! After all this time.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep2_1: Ray's old trucking friend Big Lou came on the radio from Louisville.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep2_2: Lou's alive and kicking. We swap road stories every Friday night now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep2_2: Lou was alive, and the two swap road stories every Friday night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep3_1: First frost is coming and my potatoes are still in the ground. Need sacks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep3_1: Ray asked for sacks to get his potatoes in before the first frost.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep3_2: Potatoes are in. Sent two full sacks to Pike's church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep3_2: With the sacks we sent, the potatoes came in, and two sacks went to the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep3_3: Frost got half the potatoes. Eating the rest quick.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep3_3: No sacks came, and the frost took half the potatoes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep4_1: First real snow. I want to build the girl a sled.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep4_1: When real snow fell, Ray wanted to build a sled for the girl at the farm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep4_2: Sled works. Laughed so hard on the hill I had to sit down in the snow.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep4_2: With the planks we sent, the sled was built, and Ray laughed in the snow with the girl.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep4_3: No sled. Pulled her around on a feed sack. She liked that almost as much.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep4_3: No planks came. Ray pulled the girl around on a feed sack.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep5_1: The cow I found is about to calve. Looks like a hard one.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep5_1: A cow Ray had taken in was calving, and it was a hard birth.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep5_2: Healthy calf, wobbly and loud. Up all night, and I don't regret a minute.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep5_2: With the dressings we sent, a healthy calf was born.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep5_3: The calf made it. The cow nearly didn't. We're both worn out.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep5_3: No dressings came. The calf lived, but the cow nearly died.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep6_1: Pike and I are holding a harvest supper at the church. Something sweet for the kids would be nice.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep6_1: Ray and Pike planned a harvest supper at the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep6_2: Loud and warm. The kids got candy. Pike said grace, and I said amen louder than anyone.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep6_2: With the candy we sent, the supper was warm and loud.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_rayep6_3: No sweets, but corn and squash for all. Plenty.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_rayep6_3: There were no sweets, but corn and squash enough for all.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep1_1: I started a Morse code quiz on the evening broadcast! People tap in their answers.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep1_1: Casey started a Morse code quiz on the evening broadcast.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep1_2: Half the county knows Morse now. A farmer tapped 'thank you' to me last night.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep1_2: Half the county knows Morse code now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep2_1: Old music's been playing on a weird frequency for days. I traced it to a car stereo in a lot full of the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep2_1: The mystery music came from a car stereo in a lot full of the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep2_2: There was a whole box of cassettes in that car! I play one every night now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep2_2: We cleared the lot, and Casey got a box of cassettes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep2_3: The music stopped when the battery died. I still hum the last song.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep2_3: The lot stayed overrun, and the music stopped when the battery died.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep3_1: It's my seventeenth birthday. I wasn't going to tell anyone... and I just did.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep3_1: Casey let slip that it was her seventeenth birthday.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep3_2: You sent chocolate! I ate it on the air, really slowly, and everyone sang.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep3_2: Casey ate the chocolate we sent on the air, very slowly, while everyone sang.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep3_3: No gifts, but half the county sang to me on the radio. It was enough.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep3_3: No gift came, but half the county sang to her over the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep4_1: With the power gone the sky's full of stars. I'm naming them on the air for anyone listening.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep4_1: On a night without power, Casey named the stars over the air.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep4_2: People started naming stars back. Someone named one after me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep4_2: People called in to name stars back, and someone named one after Casey.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep5_1: A boy on the Brandenburg relay keeps asking me about antennas. ...I think he likes me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep5_1: A boy on the Brandenburg relay kept asking Casey about antennas.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep5_2: We talk every night now. About antennas. Only antennas. Mostly.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep5_2: They talk every night now, about antennas. Mostly.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep6_1: A little girl from Pike's church went missing. I'm running the search on the air, and Hank tracked her to a house surrounded by the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep6_1: A girl from Pike's church went missing. Casey ran the search on the air, and Hank tracked her to a house surrounded by the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep6_2: You got her out! Hungry and scared but unhurt. The whole county cheered on the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep6_2: We cleared the house and brought the girl out, and the whole county cheered on the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_caseyep6_3: She got out alone in the night and walked to the church. Nobody knows how. Pike calls it a miracle.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_caseyep6_3: The house stayed overrun, but the girl slipped out alone in the night and walked to the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep1_1: A patient brought in a diary from the old hospital. It belonged to a nurse I worked with.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep1_1: A patient brought June a diary that had belonged to a nurse she once worked with.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep1_2: I read it every night. She wrote about me, kindly. I never knew she thought that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep1_2: June reads the diary every night; her colleague had written kindly about her.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep2_1: A man came in with an abscessed tooth. I need proper pliers, not rusty ones.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep2_1: A man with an abscessed tooth came in, and June asked for proper pliers.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep2_2: One clean pull. He hugged me afterwards. I didn't enjoy that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep2_2: With the pliers we sent, the tooth came out clean.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep2_3: Rusty pliers, three tries. He's fine, but he won't be smiling at me for a while.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep2_3: No pliers came, and it took three tries with the rusty ones.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep3_1: A winter flu is spreading. I want fever pills on hand before it gets bad.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep3_1: A winter flu spread, and June asked for fever pills.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep3_2: The flu came and went, and nobody at the clinic died. I slept through the night after.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep3_2: With the pills we sent, the flu season passed without a death.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep3_3: Without pills it was a hard two weeks. Everyone lived. Barely.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep3_3: No pills came, and after two hard weeks everyone barely pulled through.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep4_1: A man comes in every day with nothing wrong. He just sits. I think his heart is the wound.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep4_1: A man with nothing wrong came to the clinic every day and simply sat.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep4_2: I started giving him small jobs. Yesterday he laughed. I wrote it in his chart.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep4_2: June gave him small jobs, and yesterday he laughed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep5_1: My apprentice ordered me to take a day off. I don't know how. A book might help.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep5_1: Pushed by her apprentice, June took a day off and asked for a book.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep5_2: Read the whole book in the sun and fell asleep on the porch. Nobody died. Imagine that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep5_2: June read the book we sent in the sun and fell asleep on the porch.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_docep5_3: Sat on the porch for an hour with nothing to do, then went back to work. It's a start.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_docep5_3: No book came. June rested an hour and went back to work.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep1_1: The old choir hymnals are still in the chapel down the road, and the dead have taken it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep1_1: The old choir hymnals sat in a chapel the dead had taken.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep1_2: You brought the hymnals back. On Sunday we sang from real books for the first time in a year.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep1_2: We cleared the chapel and recovered the hymnals; the church sang from real books for the first time in a year.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep1_3: The hymnals stayed there. I sing from memory and people fill in the words.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep1_3: The chapel stayed overrun; Pike sings from memory and the people fill in the words.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep2_1: Behind the church are graves dug in a hurry the first weeks, no names. I want to mark them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep2_1: Pike wanted to mark the nameless graves behind the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep2_2: Every grave has a cross now. People tell me who might be there, and I carve the names.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep2_2: With the planks we sent, every grave got a cross.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep2_3: I marked the graves with stones. It will have to do.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep2_3: No planks came, and Pike marked the graves with stones.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep3_1: The children want to put on a nativity play. They need candles and sheets for costumes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep3_1: The church children planned a nativity play and asked for candles and sheets.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep3_2: It was a disaster: a shepherd cried, a wise man fell off the stage. Everyone said it was the best thing in years.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep3_2: With what we sent, the play went on; it was a mess, and everyone called it the best thing in years.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep3_3: The play went on in the dark, in everyday clothes. The children didn't mind at all.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep3_3: Nothing came; the children performed in the dark in everyday clothes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep4_1: A new refugee says loudly every supper that there's no God. I've started looking forward to it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep4_1: A new refugee declared every supper that there is no God, and Pike argued with him.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep4_2: We argue every night and agree on nothing. He fixed the church roof last week anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep4_2: They argue every night, and last week he fixed the church roof anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep5_1: The church roof is leaking right over the children's beds.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep5_1: The church roof leaked over the children's beds, and Pike asked for materials.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep5_2: Roof's fixed. The children are dry, and I can listen to the rain without worry.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep5_2: With the materials we sent, the roof was fixed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_pikeep5_3: Buckets under every leak. The children made a game of it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_pikeep5_3: No materials came; there are buckets under every leak.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep1_1: Heard there's an old stock car in a barn, surrounded by the dead. I have to see it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep1_1: Dewey heard of an old race car in a barn ringed by the dead and could not stand it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep1_2: It's real, it's beautiful, and it doesn't run. Yet. It's in the garage now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep1_2: We cleared the barn, and the race car went to Dewey's garage.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep1_3: Never got to the barn. Still think about that car.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep1_3: The barn stayed overrun, and Dewey still thinks about that car.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep2_1: Casey sent over her broken spare radio. I'm fixing it, cursing at the tiny parts.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep2_1: Dewey fixed a broken spare radio Casey sent over.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep2_2: It works. Casey cheered so loud on the air I had to turn her down.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep2_2: The radio worked again, and Casey cheered.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep3_1: Nobody's tires grip the ice. I'm making snow chains out of rope and screws.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep3_1: With the roads iced over, Dewey set out to make snow chains from rope and screws.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep3_2: Half the county's trucks have my chains. Nobody slid off the road this week.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep3_2: Chains made from the materials we sent went on half the county's trucks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep3_3: Made three sets. Everyone else drives slow.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep3_3: No materials came; there were only three sets of chains.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep4_1: Vic bet me a bottle of whiskey I couldn't fix his truck in a day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep4_1: Vic bet Dewey a bottle of whiskey she could not fix his truck in a day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep4_2: Fixed it in six hours. Vic paid and sulked. Drank it with Ray over the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep4_2: Dewey fixed the truck in six hours, and Vic paid up and sulked.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep5_1: A cat moved into the garage and sleeps on warm engines. I didn't feed it. Shut up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep5_1: A cat moved into Dewey's garage.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep5_2: It's named Carburetor now. Catches rats and judges my work.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep6_1: Vic and I are racing on the old county road. My car's held together with hope.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep6_1: Dewey and Vic set up a car race on the old county road.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep6_2: Won by a bumper. Vic demands a rematch every week. Half the county came to watch.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep6_2: Held together with the tape we sent, Dewey's car won by a bumper.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_deweyep6_3: Lost a wheel on lap two. Vic won't shut up about it. Everyone had a great time anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_deweyep6_3: No tape came, and Dewey's car lost a wheel on the second lap.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep1_1: The unit flag is still in the old armory. The dead hold it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep1_1: Whitaker's unit flag remained in an old armory held by the dead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep1_2: The flag flies over the camp again. The squad stood straighter all week.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep1_2: We cleared the armory, and the flag flies over the camp again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep1_3: The flag stays where it is. Maybe that is right.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep1_3: The armory stayed overrun, and the flag stayed with it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep2_1: A letter came through the trading post from one of the deserters. He says he is sorry.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep2_1: One of the deserters sent Whitaker a letter of apology.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep2_2: I wrote back. One line. Nobody knows what it said.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep2_2: Whitaker wrote one line back. Nobody knows what it said.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep3_1: Holding a shooting match to keep the squad sharp. Need rounds to spare.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep3_1: Whitaker asked for rounds to hold a shooting match for the squad.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep3_2: A farm girl from the militia beat every soldier. I pinned a bottle cap on her for a medal.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep3_2: With the rounds we sent, the match went on, and a farm girl won.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep3_3: No match. Drilled them on empty rifles. Not the same.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep3_3: No rounds came; they drilled with empty rifles.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep4_1: A wounded volunteer asked how I stay so calm. I told him I was a medic once, before I was a sergeant.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep4_1: Whitaker told, for the first time, that he had been a medic before he was a sergeant.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep4_2: June heard and asked me to help at the clinic twice a week. I said no. I go Tuesdays and Fridays.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep4_2: Whitaker refused June's request, and goes to the clinic every Tuesday and Friday.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep5_1: I carry a fallen soldier's dog tags. His family's house is near you, and the dead surround it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep5_1: Whitaker wanted to return a fallen soldier's dog tags to his family.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep5_2: His mother was alive. I gave her the tags and stood at attention while she cried.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep5_2: We cleared the house; the soldier's mother was alive, and Whitaker gave her the tags.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_guardep5_3: The house was empty. I hung the tags on the door handle and walked away.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_guardep5_3: The house was empty, and Whitaker hung the tags on the door handle.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep1_1: I run a card game in Coalfield Saturday nights. Everyone cheats. I cheat best.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep1_1: Vic ran a Saturday night card game in Coalfield.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep1_2: Somebody finally beat me fair and square. I laughed for a full minute.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep1_2: Someone finally beat Vic fair and square, and he laughed a long time.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep2_1: A guy from the old raiding days came to collect. Wants whiskey and won't leave without it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep2_1: A man from Vic's raiding days came to collect an old debt.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep2_2: Debt's paid. He's gone, and I feel lighter than I thought.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep2_2: With the whiskey we sent, the debt was paid.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep2_3: He took a crate of goods instead. I let him. Old debts.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep2_3: No whiskey came, and he took a crate of goods instead.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep3_1: The youngest in the crew turns fourteen. Want to give her something sweet. Tell nobody.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep3_1: Vic quietly asked for something sweet for the youngest in his crew.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep3_2: She cried when I gave it to her. Told everyone it was from you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep3_2: The youngest cried over the candy we sent.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep3_3: Gave her my good knife instead. She sleeps with it under her pillow.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep3_3: No candy came, and Vic gave her his good knife.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep4_1: There's been a stolen painting in the storeroom since the first month. Turns out the painter's still alive.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep4_1: The painter of a picture Vic had stolen turned out to be alive.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep4_2: Gave it back. She cried and gave me a sketch of Coalfield. Hangs over my stove.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep4_2: Vic returned the painting, and the artist gave him a sketch of Coalfield.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep5_1: Someone on the radio said my old prison nickname. My cellmate from county lockup is alive.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep5_1: Vic's old cellmate from county lockup came on the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep5_2: He farms now. Honest. We laughed about how neither of us saw that coming.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep5_2: The old cellmate had become an honest farmer, and the two laughed a long time.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep6_1: Ray brought vegetables, Dewey brought her toolbox, and the Coalfield market had its busiest day ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep6_1: With Ray and Dewey there, the Coalfield market had its busiest day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_ratsep6_2: By evening the three of us sat on crates, too tired to talk. Happy anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_ratsep6_2: By evening the three sat on crates, too tired to talk and happy anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep1_1: Found an orphaned bear cub by the creek. Should leave it. Haven't.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep1_1: Hank found an orphaned bear cub by the creek.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep1_2: Raised it till it could hunt, then walked it deep into the woods. It looked back once.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep1_2: Hank raised the cub and walked it back into the deep woods.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep2_1: Ray challenged me to a fishing contest over the radio. I don't lose contests.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep2_1: Ray challenged Hank to a fishing contest, and Hank asked for a rod.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep2_2: Caught a bass the size of Ray's arm. He says I cheated. I didn't.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep2_2: With the rod we sent, Hank caught a bass the size of Ray's arm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep2_3: Fished with a stick and string. Lost. Ray will never let me forget it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep2_3: No rod came, and Hank lost.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep3_1: Fresh tracks in the snow. A pack of the dead heading for the farms. They need stopping.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep3_1: Hank found tracks of a pack of the dead heading toward the farms.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep3_2: The pack never reached the farms. Nobody there will ever know.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep3_2: We stopped the pack, and the farm folk will never know.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep3_3: The pack reached a barn first. The family got out. The barn didn't.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep3_3: The pack reached a barn; the family escaped, but the barn was lost.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep4_1: A stranger stepped in one of my traps. His leg's bad. My fault.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep4_1: A stranger caught his leg in one of Hank's traps.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep4_2: Leg's set. He stays at the cabin till he can walk. Tells terrible jokes.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep4_2: With the splint we sent, his leg was set, and he is recovering at the cabin.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep4_3: Set it with a branch. He'll limp. Moved every trap off the trails.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep4_3: No splint came; he will limp, and Hank moved all his traps off the trails.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep5_1: A kid got lost in the woods at night. Taught him over the radio to find north by the stars.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep5_1: Hank talked a lost child through finding north by the stars over the radio.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_hunterep5_2: The kid walked out at dawn. Now he wants to learn every star.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_hunterep5_2: The child walked out at dawn and now wants to learn every star.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_marthaep1_1: Found Ray's old trucker hat in the barn. I've been wearing it. Don't say anything.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_marthaep1_1: Martha found Ray's trucker hat in the barn and started wearing it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_marthaep1_2: Folks call me 'Trucker Martha' now. I pretend to hate it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_marthaep2_1: Foxes keep getting into the henhouse. Need planks and nails.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_marthaep2_1: Foxes kept raiding the henhouse, and Martha asked for planks and nails.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_marthaep2_2: Henhouse is fox-proof. Eggs to trade again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_marthaep2_2: With the materials we sent, the henhouse was fixed.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_marthaep2_3: Sitting up nights with a shotgun instead. The foxes are learning.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_marthaep2_3: No materials came; Martha sits up nights with a shotgun.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_noraep1_1: My old group in Brandenburg called. They're well and want to hear about this county.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_noraep1_1: Nora's old group in Brandenburg called in.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_noraep1_2: I link the two groups on the air every Sunday now. Casey would've loved that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_noraep1_2: Every Sunday, Nora links the two groups on the air.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_noraep2_1: I want to string a longer antenna wire to reach farther.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_noraep2_1: Nora asked for wire to string a longer antenna.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_noraep2_2: The new wire reaches three more towns. My logbook needs more pages.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_noraep2_2: With the wire we sent, the broadcast reached three more towns.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_noraep2_3: The old wire will do. I'm patient.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_noraep2_3: No wire came; Nora makes do with the old one.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_samep1_1: A patient I treated wrote me a thank-you letter. My first one.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_samep1_1: Sam got his first thank-you letter from a patient.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_samep1_2: I pinned it next to June's notes. I read it when I'm scared.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_samep1_2: Sam pinned the letter beside June's notes and reads it when he is scared.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_samep2_1: I'm out of bandages. June's notes say boil and cut clean sheets.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_samep2_1: Out of bandages, Sam asked for sheets.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_samep2_2: A whole shelf of clean bandages, cut just the way June did.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_samep2_2: With the sheets we sent, Sam filled a shelf with bandages.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_samep2_3: I cut up my own shirts. It works.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_samep2_3: No sheets came, and Sam cut up his own shirts.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_estherep1_1: I want to make something sweet for the children's day at the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_estherep1_1: Esther asked for sweets for the church children's day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_estherep1_2: Children's day was sticky and loud and perfect.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_estherep1_2: With the sweets we sent, children's day was perfect.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_estherep1_3: I made a cake out of beans. The children ate it all. Don't tell them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_estherep1_3: No sweets came; Esther baked a cake from beans.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_estherep2_1: I started a children's choir. They sing loud and badly.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_estherep2_1: Esther started a children's choir at the church.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_estherep2_2: They sang at Sunday service and half the room cried. Me too.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_estherep2_2: The children sang at Sunday service, and half the room cried.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_lennyep1_1: Found a note at the bottom of Dewey's toolbox: 'If you're reading this, you're doing fine, kid.'
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_lennyep1_1: Lenny found a note at the bottom of Dewey's toolbox.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_lennyep1_2: Taped it to the garage wall. Read it every morning.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_lennyep1_2: Lenny taped the note to the garage wall.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_lennyep2_1: Got a regular customer now. Her truck needs patching every week.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_lennyep2_1: Lenny got his first regular customer.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_lennyep2_2: She tipped me a pie. Ate it in Dewey's chair.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_lennyep2_2: With the tape we sent, the truck got patched, and she tipped him a pie.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_lennyep2_3: Patched it with wire. She came back anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_lennyep2_3: No tape came, but she came back anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_kowalskiep1_1: Writing to the families of every soldier on the sergeant's list. Hardest thing I've done.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_kowalskiep1_1: Kowalski wrote to the families of the soldiers on the list.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_kowalskiep1_2: Two families wrote back. I keep their letters in my breast pocket.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_kowalskiep1_2: Two families wrote back, and Kowalski keeps their letters in his breast pocket.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_kowalskiep2_1: The supply count came up short. Someone miscounted. I'm afraid it was me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_kowalskiep2_1: Kowalski's supply count came up short.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_kowalskiep2_2: The gap is covered. Recounted three times. It was not me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_kowalskiep2_2: The rounds we sent covered the gap.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_kowalskiep2_3: Reported the shortfall honestly. The squad respected that more than I expected.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_kowalskiep2_3: No rounds came, and Kowalski reported the shortfall honestly.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_redep1_1: Started keeping an honest ledger. The crew thinks it's witchcraft.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_redep1_1: Red started keeping an honest ledger.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_redep1_2: For the first time the crew knows exactly what we own. Prouder than they'll say.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_redep1_2: For the first time the crew knows exactly what it owns.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_redep2_1: A farm family trades with us every week now. They want canned food.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_redep2_1: A farm family started trading with Red every week.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_redep2_2: They brought eggs and a thank-you drawing from their kid. Kept the drawing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_redep2_2: With the cans we sent, the trade went on, and the child sent a drawing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_redep2_3: Traded them my own rations. They'll never know.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_redep2_3: No cans came, and Red traded her own rations.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dutchep1_1: I keep a book of everyone who paid the toll. And everyone who didn't.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dutchep1_1: Dutch keeps a book of who paid the toll and who did not.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dutchep1_2: Your name in the book is underlined. Nobody knows if that's good.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dutchep1_2: Our names in Dutch's book are underlined.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dutchep2_1: One of my men ran off with the crew's shells. Replace them. Now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dutchep2_1: One of Dutch's men ran off with the shells, and Dutch demanded them replaced.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dutchep2_2: Shells replaced. Saying nothing. That's almost thanks from me.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dutchep2_2: We replaced the shells, and Dutch said nothing, which is almost thanks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_dutchep2_3: Went after him myself. Nobody's seen him since.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_dutchep2_3: No shells came; Dutch went after the man himself, and nobody has seen him since.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_calebep1_1: Found my father's bone-handled knife among Hank's things. He kept it all these years.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_calebep1_1: Caleb found his father's knife among Hank's things.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_calebep1_2: I carry it now. It fits my hand like it was waiting.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_calebep2_1: The cabin roof needs fixing before the rains. I'm a carpenter, at least.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_calebep2_1: Caleb asked for materials to fix the cabin roof.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_calebep2_2: The cabin's better than it's ever been. Hank would've grumbled about that.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_calebep2_2: With the materials we sent, the cabin is better than ever.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Story_calebep2_3: Patched it with bark. It holds. Mostly.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Tale_calebep2_3: No materials came, and Caleb patched the roof with bark.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Voice_Cold: They seem to have heard we let the last one down. Trust has to be built again from nothing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_supply_drop: Set some things aside for you. Building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. Get it before someone else does.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_fetch_1: One favor. There should be a %4 in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. Radio me when you have it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_rescue_1: Caught a distress call. Someone's stuck in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. My knees won't get me there. You go.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_reward_1: Thanks. What I promised is in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_reward_trad: Got your payment. The goods are in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_reward_hord: You cleared them. Good. Your due is in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_horde_1: About %4 of the dead are crowding a building near %1, %3 tiles %2 of you. Clear them and I'll make it worth it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_horde_warni: Watch out! About %1 of them coming at you from the %2.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_horde_thank: All gone. Ray had a reason for trusting you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_rescue_fail: Nobody went... I keep thinking about them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_donation_1: You sent all this? Thanks. None of it gets wasted.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_heli_1: Hear that chopper? Flying low. The dead will follow it. Keep away.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_player_died: Heard about %1... won't hear that voice again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_survived_1: Nearly the end. Still holding on, though.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_fate_warn_1: We're out of near everything. Can't last like this.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_fate_goodby: This is my last call. Take care of yourselves. Thank you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_project_don: The greenhouse is done! Ray would've loved it. That's your doing.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_project_pro: Greenhouse is about %1%% done. Finishing what Ray started.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_crisis_appe: Heard about the %1? I need your hands. Pick in your quest log.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_crisis_than: That choice helped us too. Thanks.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_crisis_snub: So you helped them. Fine... still stings.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_world_power: Power's out. Fridge is done. Back to the old ways.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_world_water: Taps are dry. Start catching rain.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_world_winte: Winter's here. Stack plenty of wood.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_chat_miss_1: Haven't heard from you in days. Still alive?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_gift_1: This one's free. Don't want anything for it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_open_chat_1: Everyone make it through today? Farm's quiet.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_duo_warm_op: %1, all quiet there? Good to hear you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_duo_warm_re: Thanks, %1. Getting by, thanks to you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_martha_duo_cold_op: %1, not a voice I'm glad to hear. Alive, I see.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_survived_1: It nearly ended. But I'm still here.

IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_crisis_snub_: You helped them. I understand... it stings a little.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_crisis_ignor: Nobody answered. That's how it went.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_world_power_: The power's out. Never had it out here anyway.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_world_water_: The water's off. Boil any creek water.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_world_winter: Winter's here. Stack plenty of firewood.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_chat_miss_1: No word in days. I was worried. Are you all right?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_gift_1: Take this one. I don't want anything for it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_open_chat_1: Ekron woods here. Is everyone all right?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_duo_warm_ope: %1, all right there? It's good to hear you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_duo_warm_rep: Thank you, %1. Holding on, thanks to you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_storm_: %1, the sky looks bad. Get ready for a storm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_heli_1: %1, did you hear the helicopter? It went over the woods.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_power_: %1, the power's gone for good. We'll all live like woodsmen now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_water_: %1, the water's off too. Boil what you drink.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_winter: %1, it's cold. Do you have enough firewood?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_share_: %1, did you get what was sent? We help each other.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_clash_: %1, there was shooting near Coalfield. I heard it from the woods.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_topic_holida: %1, today is %2. My father always smoked meat on this day.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_player_greet: %1, good to hear you. I'm glad you're safe.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_player_help_: %1, are you badly hurt? Get somewhere safe first. Try the clinic too.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_player_trade: If you need goods, pick me on the radio tab and use [Ask to trade], %1.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_player_info_: The woods are quiet, %1. Careful on the roads.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_horde_1: Pay with work instead. The dead are crowding a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. Please clear them.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_scout_1: Scout for me instead. First stop is a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. Go in and watch a while; I'll tell you the next one after. Some dead inside.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_guard_1: Hold that place for me instead. A building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you. Stay a while. They'll come.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_courier: Would you carry a parcel? Pick it up in a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you, and take it where I say.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_credit_: I'll trust you with it now. Please pay within %1 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_favor_1: Take it. Just do me a favor later.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_done_1: Good work. I added a little extra.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_work_paid_1: Well done. The goods are on their way.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_favor_call_1: Remember the favor you owe? I'm asking now. I need %1.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_volunteer_as: I have nothing to pay you with, but thank you. It's a building near %1, about %3 tiles %2 of you.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_volunteer_do: You did it for nothing. I won't forget.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_reward_waive: You'd leave that for me? Thank you. I'll use it well.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_holiday_soon: %1 is coming. It would be good to mark it together. Could you gather a few things?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Line_caleb_holiday_feas: Happy %1. I sent a little smoked meat.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_martha: Supplies are on their way. Don't worry.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_nora: I've marked your map. I'll warn you if anything gets close.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_sam: Good. Keep the wound clean, okay?
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_esther: It's all right. Breathe slowly. I'm right here.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_lenny: Heading out to fix your car! Hang on!
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_red: I'll have the boys make some noise. Move while they do.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_dutch: I'll make some noise. It isn't free.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_caleb: I'll cover you. Keep your head down.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec_lenny_don: Car's fixed! Take it for a spin!

IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_livestock: Ray and the neighbors bring animals nearby: three hens and a rooster (80 percent), a sow (10 percent) or a milk cow (10 percent). You feed and water them. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_livestoc: Brought you some animals. Feed them well.
Brought you three hens and a rooster. Feed them well.
Brought you a sow. Feed her well and you'll have piglets.
Brought you a milk cow. You know how to milk her?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_rain: Rain for 12 hours from 6 the next morning (fills rain barrels, waters crops). No one can use it while it runs. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_rain: Rain's coming. Set out your barrels.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_rain_sta: Rain's falling. Hope your barrels are out.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_rain_sto: Rain's passed. Hope it filled your barrels.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_stew: Ray puts a pot of his stew straight into your inventory (very filling, lifts mood) and for 24 hours your unhappiness does not rise. Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_stew: Packed you a pot of stew. Eat it warm.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_praise: Tonight's broadcast praises you. Next morning every contact's trust +2 (not above 90). Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_praise_d: Everyone heard last night's show! You're all anyone's talking about this morning.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_sos: Press it for an hour of five kinds of help at once: one guard soldier (a marksman without A-Life), Hank shooting 15, no panic or stiffness, Vic's crew making a decoy racket, no slowdown from pain. Help from contacts who left is skipped. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_sos: Got your SOS! Everyone's on the way!
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_sos_done: That's the hour. Everyone's pulling back. You're okay, right?
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_power: Only after the grid is down. Power comes back for 3 days (does not affect the repair operation). No one can use it while it runs. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_power: Power's patched. It should hold three days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_power_so: My patch on the grid won't hold much longer. Use the power while you can.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_power_en: Power's out again. The patch gave up.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_illness: Cures food poisoning, poison, a cold and corpse sickness, and keeps them away for 3 days. Not zombie infection. Only when you are sick. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_illness: Do as I said and you'll be fine.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_illness_: That's as long as my advice keeps you clear. Be careful again from here.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_pain: For 3 days pain does not slow you down. Wounds stay as they are. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_pain: I'll keep the pain down. Don't overdo it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_pain_end: The pain regimen ends here. It will start hurting again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_pharmacy: Send medicinal herbs you carry and June makes up to 2 medicines, straight into your inventory. Vitamins, sleeping pills, beta blockers, antidepressants, painkillers or disinfectant take 6 herbs each, antibiotics 8. Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_pharmacy: Your medicine is ready, it's in your bag.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_reconcile: Makes peace with the contact who trusts you least: trust +10, lifts a credit ban and clears 'abandoner' and 'unreliable'. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_reconcil: I talked it through with %1. It will be all right now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_refugees: For a day refugees clear corpses within 25 tiles of your home (while someone is near so the area is loaded). Needs a known home. Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_refugees: The hands are back. They cleared %1 bodies.
The hands are back. They found nothing to clear.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_baptism: For 2 days your endurance drains at a third of the usual rate. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_baptism_: The blessing has run its course. Spare your strength now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_tow: Picks the car within 10 tiles. In 1-2 hours (30 min with the Ark) a fueled pickup arrives and you get its key; tow the car with it. The truck is taken back after 48 hours when nobody is in or near it. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_tow_here: Truck's there. She's hooked to your car and the key's in your pocket. I want her back in two days.
Truck's there. Key's in your pocket, hook your car up yourself. I want her back in two days.
Left the truck by your car. Key's in the glove box. I want her back in two days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_tow_off: Couldn't find your car, so I turned the truck around. Call me again from right beside it.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_tow_soon: I'm coming for the truck soon. Get your stuff out of her.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_tow_back: Got my truck back. Hope she did you right.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_reinforce: A car within 10 tiles takes no damage for 6 hours and keeps its speed through zombies and grass while you accelerate (big crashes still stop it). Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_reinforc: The bracing's done for. Ram anything now and she'll break.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_tuning: Permanently tunes the engine of a car within 10 tiles: quality 100, 1.3x power, quieter. Once per car. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_artillery: Opens a targeting radar (a map around you: buildings, zombies, people). Click to aim and it shows the zombies, density and nearest person there; [Call] drops three shells 10 minutes later (within 240 tiles, at least 15 from every player). Kills zombies within 10 tiles and is very loud (heard from far away). Spots too far to be loaded only get the noise. Held if anyone is within 12 tiles. Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_artiller: Splash confirmed. Fire mission complete. The noise will draw them, stay clear.
Friendlies too close to the target. Mission scrubbed. Call it in again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_evac: When home is more than 100 tiles away, a helicopter flies you home in 20 minutes (loud where it picks you up). In multiplayer the server's speed anti-cheat must be 3 (log) or 4 (off). Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_evac_don: Touchdown confirmed. Bird is heading home.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_barricade: Used near home (within 60 tiles), puts metal sheet barricades on up to 8 outer windows on your home's ground floor (doors stay open), repairs damaged walls, fences and doors within 12 tiles re-glazes broken windows and hangs a wooden door in up to 4 empty outer door frames. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_barricad: Engineers are done. %1 windows sheeted, %2 repairs, %3 new doors hung.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_heist: Vic's crew loots the building you pick on the map in 6-10 hours and puts the haul straight into your inventory. Vic's cut grows with the haul (30 percent up to value 20, 50 percent to 50, 70 percent to 100, 85 percent above), and what he takes is picked at random. Its containers end up empty. Not for buildings over 12 rooms or 1500 tiles, gun stores, military or police sites, your home or places already hit. Wait 14 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_heist: Sending my boys in. Give it the night. I take my cut.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_heist_do: Job's done. Handing you %1 things. I kept about %2 percent.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_heist_em: We hit it. Nothing worth carrying. Came back empty.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_bodyguard: With A-Life two of Vic's crew guard you for 24 hours; without it they take out dead that get close for 12 hours. Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_bodyguar: My boys are on you. You owe me.
Calling my boys back. Watch your own back now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_camo: For 4 hours zombies do not chase you. Sprinting or attacking breaks it. Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_camo_end: The stink's worn off. They'll know you now.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_camo_bro: Told you not to run or swing. Your cover's blown.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_suppressor: For a day the guns you carry are much quieter (including ones you pick up meanwhile). Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_suppress: Suppressors are shot. Your guns are loud again.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_game: Hank puts 4 to 8 pieces of meat straight into your inventory (better cuts are rarer). Eat them before they spoil. Wait 7 days.
IGUI_StoryEngine_RadioSay_spec2_game: Handed you some meat. Eat it before it turns.
IGUI_StoryEngine_Spec2_Desc_flare: Lights up 12 tiles around you for 6 hours (others see it too). Wait 7 days.
